I was the first Member of Congress to talk about my own period on the House floor, so I’m not afraid to say this:
I went on birth control in high school for debilitating cramps. I've used Plan B. I have an IUD.
These aren’t niche topics or wedge issues. Birth control is part of basic health care for me and for millions of others all around the country, and we deserve the right to access it.
But that right is under attack from a GOP hell-bent on controlling our bodies and our lives.
Earlier this month, Senate Republicans actually voted to BLOCK legislation that would have guaranteed access to contraception for all. It should have been one of the easiest votes they’ve ever taken, but instead, they chose to further alienate more than half the population and show yet again that they’ll put their extreme anti-choice agenda ahead of the values of the vast majority of Americans every chance they get.
If we want to restore reproductive freedom at the federal level and protect our fundamental rights, we absolutely must take back the House in November.
The good news is that it’s possible – but it won’t happen without hard work. We need to fight every day between now and November 5th to reach every voter and ensure they know the stakes of this election.

Did you see Ted Cruz's interview, Derek?

We all saw with our own eyes what happened after the 2020 election: Ted Cruz cheered on the mob on January 6, led the objection to the election results certification, and then hid in a supply closet.
**And spoiler alert:** He's ready to do it again.
**We can’t let him. This November is our chance to finally hold him accountable by kicking him out of the Senate for good.**
**Polls currently show him and Colin Allred TIED in Texas, but this is shaping up to be the most expensive race in the country.[So please, will you chip in $100, $50, $10, or whatever to Adam Schiff and Colin’s campaign and to help Colin defeat Ted Cruz and bring real, pro-democracy leadership to Texas?](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2907?c0=june2024_abs_em_allred.YWOHSW&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_EOQ_AC90_20240623_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=6780%2E5257348%2E74oenV)**

Ted Cruz has proven time and again to be the single most divisive politician in Washington. From leading the charge on the 2012 government shutdown to ushering in an era of extreme hyper-partisanship and pitting Americans against each other with dangerous, extremist rhetoric.**_Ted isn't just Texans' problem – he's ALL AMERICANS’ problem._ **
Ted Cruz's refusal to commit to accepting election results is _exactly_ the kind of rhetoric that led to January 6, and another six years of him in the Senate is a danger our democracy simply can’t afford.

subject: July Cookout Invite
body:
Join us July 7th, 1-4pm, Bernice Pyke Park, Lakewood for a cook out with Tristan, family, and friends. All are welcome!! | |
---
| | |
#### Join Tristan Rader July 7th 1-4pm for our
# Lakewood July Cookout
---
|
---
|
---
|
---
---
|
---
|
---
| _Dear Friends & Supporters,_ I am excited to invite you to a summer cookout to enjoy delicious food, great company, and a fun-filled afternoon. This event is a fantastic opportunity for us to come together, celebrate our community, and discuss the future of our district. Whether you're a long-time supporter or new to our campaign, I would love to connect with you and share my vision for a brighter, more sustainable Ohio. **Event Details:** **Date:** Sunday, July 7th
**Time:** 1:00 PM - 4:00 PM
**Location:** Bernice Pyke Park, Lakewood, Ohio (near downtown Lakewood) **Highlights:**
* **Great Food and Drinks:** Free hot dogs, burgers, vegetarian options, and cold drinks will be provided. Adult beverages will be available at my house across the street at 1348 St. Charles.
* **Music:** Enjoy some fantastic tunes while you mingle and relax.
* **Fun Games:** Participate in various games and activities for all ages.
* **Community Spirit:** Connect with fellow supporters and community members.
* **Free Parking:** Conveniently located at the park, on Belle and St. Charles Avenues, and behind Geiger’s.

This is a wonderful opportunity to enjoy a fantastic time together while supporting our campaign for a sustainable and just Ohio. Your support is vital, and donations are welcome and appreciated to help us continue making a difference, but not required to attend. **All are welcome, come as you are! ** **[Act Blue ](https://tristanrader.us15.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe296f262404fb3f98dc9e04f&id=94046ca711&e=869bcf0641)********[RSVP Here](https://tristanrader.us15.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe296f262404fb3f98dc9e04f&id=cf12e2555a&e=869bcf0641)**
\- Or -
**[Facebook Event RSVP Here](https://tristanrader.us15.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fe296f262404fb3f98dc9e04f&id=90494bc434&e=869bcf0641)** I look forward to seeing you there and having a great time with you. Please feel free to bring your family and friends! **Parking Information:**
* **Bernice Pyke Park Parking Lot (limited)**
* **On Belle & St. Charles Avenues Street Parking**
* **Public Lot A-C, Behind Geiger’s & Melt **

Thank you for your continued support. Let's come together to support a brighter future for Ohio and enjoy a good old-fashioned summer cookout together! In solidarity, **_Tristan Rader
Candidate for State Representative,
State House District 13_**

body:
Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**June 23, 2024** **SUNDAY NEWS DIGEST** **By Heidi Ganahl**
| | Hi Readers,
We have a big week in politics ahead -- the [primary election](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) is Tuesday, and the very first presidential debate is Thursday. Make sure you stay up to date by following along with our newsletters and social media!

In Colorado, political candidates have been vigorously campaigning for months, reaching out to voters across various districts, culminating in the primary elections. Notably, the 4th District has seen a [flurry of activity](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) with a dozen candidates initially competing for the Republican nomination to succeed U.S. Rep. Ken Buck. High-profile races include Kristi Burton Brown fighting for a [State Board of Education seat](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and intense contests in the [8th District](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) between Gabe Evans and Janak Joshi, with the winner to face Democrat Yadira Caraveo. Congressional [District 3 and 5](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) are also heated races for conservatives.

As the primary approaches, candidates are making final efforts to engage with voters, [emphasizing their platforms](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) which range from securing borders, improving education, to economic issues.

The 4th District race is particularly contentious with U.S. Rep. Lauren Boebert, Richard Holtorf, Mike Lynch, Peter Yu, Deborah Flora and Jerry Sonnenberg. Candidates are [leveraging their backgrounds](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and local support to appeal to voters.

Polls suggest Boebert holds a [significant lead](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), however, all candidates continue their vigorous campaigning efforts underscoring the unpredictable nature of primaries and the high stakes involved in these electoral contests.
\---
**Voting Information:**
* **Primary Election Day:** Tuesday, June 25.
* Registration can be completed in person at a voting center until 7 p.m. on Election Day.
* You can track your ballot at [BallotTrax.coloradosos.gov](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).

Have a great week ahead,
Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
| | **STATE**
---
**[In low-turnout primary election, 4th District outperforming others with 17.1% of all ballots cast](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) It may not be a historically-low turnout as many candidates from all corners of Colorado fear, but the primary election certainly doesn't appear to be shattering any records.
**[Group tied to Kent Thiry drops $1.1 million into Colorado legislative primaries in final days before election](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) ** [THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) A group tied to Kent Thiry, the wealthy former CEO of the Denver-based dialysis giant DaVita, is spending nearly $1.1 million on TV and digital ads in 13 state legislative races in the days leading up to Colorado's primaries on Tuesday.
**[Colorado to see'enormous decrease' in revenue, less TABOR refunds because of new tax laws](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) The latest revenue forecast for Colorado's state government reflected the effects of some of the 30 laws approved this year that changed tax policy, resulting in less revenue for state operations and decreased Taxpayer's Bill of Rights refunds to residents.
**[Colorado ends budget year $164M in the red with potential tax cuts looming on November ballot](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) The state of Colorado will end its budget year June 30 with a deficit of as much as $164 million, forcing it to dip into its reserves as it heads into an election cycle fraught with financial uncertainty.
_**[READ MORE STATE NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**_
|
---
**NATIONAL**
**[GOP resolution calls on SCOTUS to'intervene' in Trump's hush money case](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [POLITICO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Rep. William Timmons (R-S.C.) introduced a resolution Friday urging the Supreme Court to "intervene" in the hush money case against former President Donald Trump before the 2024 election -- a move that experts say is a political stunt that faces significant legal obstacles.
**[Senate Republicans propose bill slashing taxes from tips](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE WASHINGTON TIMES](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Senate Republicans recently crafted legislation off of former President Donald Trump's proposal to eliminate federal taxes from tips off of wages.
**[Supreme Court upholds ban on gun ownership by those under domestic violence court orders](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE DAILY SIGNAL](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) The Supreme Court upheld the federal law banning gun ownership by those under domestic violence restraining orders on Friday morning.

**[READ MORE NATIONAL NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**LOCAL**
**[Colorado wildlife officials confirm Grand County wolves have reproduced](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) At least one pup has been born to a pair of wolves transplanted to Colorado from Oregon in December. Colorado Parks and Wildlife on Thursday evening said a gray wolf pup was spotted on June 18 in Grand County but said it is likely as many as five more were born.
**[In Colorado, only one town lets nonresidents vote. Now it's considering adding LLCs to voter rolls.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) When the town of Mountain Village above Telluride incorporated in 1995, emerging from a special district, the town charter allowed nonresident property owners to vote. Mountain Village is still the only town in Colorado that allows nonresidents to vote in local elections for council members, mayors and new regulations.
**[El Paso County schools receive BEST grant funding for renovations](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO SPRINGS GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Three school districts across El Paso County are among this year's recipients of the Colorado Department of Education's annual Building Excellent Schools Today (BEST) Grant funding.
**[Thanks to illegals, enrollment slump for Denver schools comes to an end](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE CENTER SQUARE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) Denver Public Schools saw a boost in enrollment for the first time since the pandemic thanks to a surge of migrant students, according to a report the school board received this week.
_**[READ MORE LOCAL NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**_
|
---
**COMMENTARY**
**[McGuire: What does the Student Intifada want?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [CITY JOURNAL](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _With few exceptions, college and university presidents were slow and ineffective in responding to the protests and encampments on their campuses this spring. Their passivity calls to mind the character Gottlieb Biedermann in Max Frisch 's play The Fire Raisers, who, hearing about a series of local arsons, refuses to believe that the men who manipulated their way into occupying his attic could be the perpetrators._
**[Harsanyi: Stop trying to convince me Joe Biden isn't a confused, doddering old man](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE FEDERALIST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _Listen, I 'd support a zombie for president if they promised to nominate originalists for the Supreme Court and deregulate the economy. Do whatever you have to do. But stop telling me that Joe Biden isn't a mentally and physically fragile man._
**[McKenna: Of our race-obsessed schools and special populations](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _The Cherry Creek School Board meeting in April featured a strategic plan update on special populations by Dr. Tony Poole. Those not steeped in the priorities of the school board and Superintendent Chris Smith might think it wise to fixate on "disproportionality" as Dr. Poole does; but that fixation does not seem to be improving proficiency in reading or math, where half the district's students do not test at grade level. Or much else._
**[Davidson: The need for the Electoral College as illustrated by baseball](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [TOWN HALL](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) _Democrats are upset when a Republican who did not win the popular vote is elected president by virtue of winning at least 270 electoral votes. This happened most recently in 2000 and 2016. I would be upset if the tables were turned. _
_**[READ MORE COMMENTARY](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**_
|
---

|
---

I returned to New York City for a few days to handle some business with my law practice (you know - that thing I do to make a living). At the suggestion of a good friend, I popped into the Broadway musical "Suffs", co-produced by Hillary Clinton and Malala Yousafzai. It tells the story of the last 5-8 years of the fight for women's suffrage.
The message could not be more timely. Here are some edited snips of the lyrics from the song, "How Long?"
> _How long must women wait for liberty?_
> _How long must we wait?_
> _Must we wait?_
> _How many more marches in the streets?_
> _How many more efforts gone to waste?_
> _How many more deafening defeats?_
> _How many more histories erased?_
> _How many more dignities deferred?_
> _How many more told to know our place?_
> _How many more girls will go unheard?_
> _How many more doors shut in our face?_
> _How many more Joans burned at the stake?_
> _How many more of us will it take?_
> _How long?_
> _How long til it 's too late?_
> _Will we wait?_
> _We won 't wait another day_
Naturally, I thought about the abortion bans sweeping the country. Honestly, we don't do it justice to label the initiatives "abortion bans". They plan to ban all forms of hormonal therapy. Contraception - denied. Hormonal treatment for symptoms of menopause - denied. Transgender therapies - denied.
Curiously, they have not mentioned hormonal treatments for men.
What about Viagra? Cialis? Will those therapies also be denied? Or are men (other than trans men) excluded from these onerous laws?
The writers did an excellent job of portraying the inner struggles of the movement. They didn't all bask in sisterly love. Not all women saw the fruits of their labor. African American women, Asian women, Native women, had their rights to vote denied in many states, even after the passage of the 19th Amendment in 1920. The Voting Rights Act, which gave the right to vote to all, didn't come along until 1965.
Go see "Suffs" when you get a chance.
Take some Kleenex. And be prepared to be motivated to _Keep Marching_.
_If we haven 't met yet, I am Paula Collins, the Democratic and Working Families Party Candidate for New York's 21st Congressional District. Your comments are invaluable to me. Please let me hear from you. Remember that you can always visit my website at www.paulacollinsforcongress.com or by sending me a text at 315-230-3920. _

Ron DeSantis during the 2024 Republican presidential primary, had some harsh words for presumptive Republican nominee for president Donald Trump – calling the former president a “disaster,” and suggesting in a bizarre social media post that a majority of GOP voters don’t support the 2nd Amendment.

The Safe Suburbs USA PAC (https://safesuburbsusa.com/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=107292ac59-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) , which Coyne founded in 2021 “to promote public safety and the welfare of suburban residents,” raises money to support and endorse pro-law enforcement candidates. In 2022, the PAC received two donations totaling $5,500 (https://www.elections.il.gov/CampaignDisclosure/ContributionSearchByCommittees.aspx?txtCmteName=02aNhA5ZslgPm755Lmmj5QnRzWOWZpFvR8W%2bX6yc2ro%3d&ddlCmteNameSearchType=%2fOm8zAJ7f4ioTTB90BLGGijKP5NjRbIx&ddlVendorState=Ry707kcsXsM%3d&ddlContributionType=wOGh3QTPfKqV2YWjeRmjTeStk426RfVK&ddlState=Ry707kcsXsM%3d&ddlFiledDateTime=Ry707kcsXsM%3d&ddlFiledDateTimeThru=Ry707kcsXsM%3d&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=107292ac59-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) from Illinois House GOP leader Jim Durkin – a friend and confidant of outgoing IL GOP chairman Don Tracy and infamous Never Trumper.

In November 2022, the day after the election, Durkin announced (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/01/breaking-house-gop-leader-jim-durkin-resigning-says-trump-republicans-2nd-amendment-and-pro-life-issues-dragged-gop-down-in-midterm-election.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=107292ac59-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) that he was resigning as House Minority Leader. During the midterm election, Durkin suffered embarrassing losses, giving House Democrats once again, supermajority control in the Illinois House. And just days before resigning from office, Durkin was the only Republican to join the Democrats, voting in favor of Democratic Gov. JB Pritzker’s unconstitutional assault weapons ban – a move that angered Republicans across the state.

In media interviews after announcing his resignation as House GOP leader, Durkin attempted to place all of the blame on former President Donald Trump, saying (https://www.chicagobusiness.com/politics/trump-blamed-illinois-gop-losses-house-gop-leader-jim-durkin?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=107292ac59-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) , “As long as we continue to say that we are the party of Trump and that we have to abide by the party principles in the platform, 100% we’re gonna continue down this path of losing.”

In February, during an interview with a local news publication favored (https://www.theillinoize.com/articles/suburban-republicans-plan-trump-problem?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=107292ac59-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) by Tracy, Coyne said, “In the suburbs, Trump is political poison. Anyone on the ballot is facing a huge uphill climb when you have that kind of disaster at the top [of the ticket].” Coyne went on in an attempt to further distance himself from Trump, and “remind people that all Republicans are not the same.”

Back in August, Coyne’s PAC posted on X a “post mugshot poll” – taking a shot at Trump, who had his mugshot taken earlier in the day in Fulton County, Georgia as part of disgraced District Attorney Fani Willis’ election fraud investigation. Trump dominated the poll, beating DeSantis by 35 points.

On Sunday, Safe Suburbs USA PAC posted on X slamming the grassroots Trump Republicans in Illinois who are gaining influence in the state and suggested that a majority of Republican voters are not pro-life or pro-2nd Amendment, writing,

“Once you cross 88, Trump isn’t popular even with Republicans and even a great many R voters don’t identify as either pro-Life or pro-2A. More embarrassing elections to come for the ILGOP if the plan is to run far Right candidates statewide or in the suburbs.”

The PAC has also taken aim and blamed the conservative base of the party for Tracy’s resignation, posting, “Let’s run far Right candidates in deep Blue State in which R voters are fleeing by the day and in which the GOP faces a 20 to 1 financial disparity. This strategy should work swimmingly...for Democrats!”

Several days ago, Tracy submitted his resignation (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/embattled-il-gop-chairman-don-tracy-resigns-effective-july-19-blames-rise-of-grassroots-leaves-behind-a-record-of-massive-gop-losses.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=107292ac59-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) as party chairman effective July 19th – blaming the rise of the “grassroots,” party infighting and the removal of state central committee member Mark Shaw as vice chairman of the party without “due process” as the embattled leader of the IL GOP presided over widespread and massive losses during his brief tenure as chairman.

Over a week ago, Vince Kolber, who served as chairman of the IL GOP Finance Committee, abruptly resigned (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/breaking-vince-kolber-who-votes-in-il-wi-resigns-as-il-gop-finance-chairman-blames-grassroots-for-his-downfall.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=107292ac59-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) in an angry letter to Tracy, just weeks after the influential conservative grassroots base of the Illinois Republican Party scored major victories during the GOP State Convention in Collinsville – and after two years of unflattering stories by this publication. Kolber, who is registered to vote in Illinois and Wisconsin, was still angry about losing his election at the state convention for national committeeman – after being eliminated in the first round to Mark Shaw, who faked a delegate badge, voted illegally and threatened to beat up a fellow state central committee member. During the first day of the convention, the Republican National Committeeman nominating committee voted 14-3 to keep Kolber on the ballot
despite failing to meet the candidacy requirements as outlined by the IL GOP’s own bylaws.

The Safe Suburbs USA PAC has just named the candidates the organization will be endorsing (https://safesuburbsusa.com/2024-endorsements/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=107292ac59-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) during the 2024 election cycle:

body:
Here's my story| | | [](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=646807f501b74bc3bc55bc693c4c0e17&_e=n2S3bwastWRkvwtTCQD7C4XQLPnV8Eh37jmzkIgLku5y-sdzYUudWE5y4qdhYazMGyQk1-eDt6ZLm4msxHq8souQ74iQLSCy9_7xD9aiQ9oGf0Ruza_ugmUQABVJ0guRR4STN0kyCgqMQDKoKmf4RITcqfGCTafFWh3Sbo4ItwkLr2wl5ERxqA6h5dDI5pOleXXt3wbWNA7KE8h4M2X3if7eGk2mj3VNnzl3W4lpqsock8iOcttIzS253aqzeo4WVL3HArUPiU-TtVdb3ERsa3u8AdV2o_SkujqOgB8p3dYUkpsJReco4x2mscYW97oQWQeednHaPqTAPvIH-s5Rov6TqNN25wsb6-Zc8wqyQ9hBjpDl4ADl7bHPi2V9wbVn)
---
Fellow Patriot, My name is Hung Cao. I am a retired Navy Captain who served for 25 years in Special Operations. I served on the front lines defusing bombs for our SEAL teams and Special Forces; I also conducted some of the most dangerous deep dives in the military.
---
[](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=646807f501b74bc3bc55bc693c4c0e17&_e=n2S3bwastWRkvwtTCQD7C4XQLPnV8Eh37jmzkIgLku5y-sdzYUudWE5y4qdhYazMGyQk1-eDt6ZLm4msxHq8souQ74iQLSCy9_7xD9aiQ9oGf0Ruza_ugmUQABVJ0guRR4STN0kyCgqMQDKoKmf4RITcqfGCTafFWh3Sbo4ItwkLr2wl5ERxqA6h5dDI5pOleXXt3wbWNA7KE8h4M2X3ifnMlDUrRtSv3U0LjBeQTHJXFNewQtaDsK7fOnBvjQJdmR42mkgIt_5AYGJtgJSf3XC02kQ3aslTL6G__6lCYgFE42orpjCNPW3LvCQ_jlTG_QBfHk78faG7LLDDqKzqbFKyZHTBrqD0zq9VQ8Ptih6yPh5-tT9dcGoH4tGsmLoI)
---
I was inspired to serve because America gave me everything. **My family escaped Communist Vietnam to the United States after the fall of Saigon. **
---
[](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=646807f501b74bc3bc55bc693c4c0e17&_e=n2S3bwastWRkvwtTCQD7C4XQLPnV8Eh37jmzkIgLku5y-sdzYUudWE5y4qdhYazMGyQk1-eDt6ZLm4msxHq8souQ74iQLSCy9_7xD9aiQ9oGf0Ruza_ugmUQABVJ0guRR4STN0kyCgqMQDKoKmf4RITcqfGCTafFWh3Sbo4ItwkLr2wl5ERxqA6h5dDI5pOleXXt3wbWNA7KE8h4M2X3iYQgscM6I3ITpyJslKKK8jWyTBCuHFbFYvwH6hwW2EYJIMhvA6BtbYU9YJaUc7dImQg1tHkTJRpyAgaKPqhV6absTdfEWa9pE0-PtaSeWxmV4jwMefr4EW0AEBHVNg-xh25_QEGYQ_bfP8QOVgEdzGdlVBJGGnb93h5xR5nTANTj)
---
_If it wasn't for America, I probably wouldn't be alive today._

differently. They want activist judges to legislate from the
bench.

Do you agree that the role of the
Supreme Court is to apply the Constitution as it is written and
NOT to make laws or advance a particular policy agenda?

YES

Even worse, progressives dismayed by
recent Supreme Court decisions want to "pack" the bench with
additional justices to advance a preferred policy agenda.

As Sen. Elizabeth Warren (D-Mass.) put

a broken institution, Congress must expand the Supreme Court by
four or more seats."

That is why I'm reaching out to you
today...

What is your opinion about the Supreme

## Mass Shooting at Arkansas Store
Four people were killed and 14 others were injured in [a mass shooting](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO6yAQRb_G7hzBeABTULwmXV67pUVgxmaXmAhQovz9Kqm3u1enOTpfl_XiU07H9t_fyHUuqw89PWjVE-AEuOIYHRMBzSM5aaSF2Rilx93NEhQo5QMa1FZfmQEZBWCkGFiqMTkQgEIDSgFS2JOPsLACQG0WYyMPKCimXurpu6Sj78T5VR5UT6Hcxuz23u9tmP8NcB7g7O8HPdsbvU_tKWT6rB9_NN-mrZZA9TW1XipNbS-lp2ObwIdwjYbnK7GxiwkLBr-whKBFJG3H6uL9mXJOTZsBxXbzKX8E-t85Hg5-AwAA__-7EmGe) at Mad Butcher, a local grocery store in Fordyce, Arkansas, a small town about 65 miles south of Little Rock. Police say 44-year-old Travis Eugene Posey of New Edinburg opened fire at the store from the parking lot, riddling cars with bullet holes as panicked bystanders ducked and scrambled for cover amid a barrage of gunfire. Posey, who engaged in a shootout with police before being injured and arrested, now faces multiple charges, including four counts of capital murder. Among the [four people killed in the shooting](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7FuwyAQgOGnwZstfBCIB4Yu3tK1o3WBI74Wmwiorbx91c6d_-HX93FbbsiJ98c7buRazAv6xgctpgfdg150F1wkAlIdudGOEyhrL6Zbnb0rHCd_l4QeyBuJ3kQPRo0otfKhYwcStDSgRwmjnAYMcI0XAG3s1U4hCi0pcMtl-My8t5VieuWDyuDz1iW3tvasQr0JmAXM53kO4VkHLF-4V6zDIx8C5p3OKmCO-bu0tY-5hJen_mDfeOsD02_sigvPk1PiaqzQ8rEhp79J-598OPgJAAD__02bWdQ) was Callie Weems, a 23-year-old nurse who was shot while giving aid to other victims. Two police officers were among the 14 injured.
## Trump Says He's Decided on His VP
Former President Donald Trump told reporters that he's decided on his running mate for the 2024 presidential election, but "nobody knows" his choice yet. He [hinted that his selected candidate](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFy6yAQAL8GOjxwwoAKiteo82tTajB32JcgoZGIMvn7jFOn3mJ39u023xJXXh__00Kxlzan3Pmk2SmwCuxsJcZCBDRIisabEQbvr04-Y8i--IQBPAZECIPWFs3daUqQ75YkR9BgtQNrNBg9XhJCKFcA63zwIxZhNSH3tl_eG6_9SaV-t5P2S26LrPHZ-3aI4Z-AScDUeaEXEDC5cTRaewETtjVVVH3_XDaFlBnpUCdnUttOByOtXW2cP9SrRFGl3LmtAia5R9y-uFY-nBdWP5bE9dfb_75wRvgJAAD__zaVXjg) would attend the upcoming debate against President Joe Biden in Atlanta this Thursday. Trump senior adviser Brian Hughes stated that the [campaign's top criterion](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFvwyAUhH8N3rDgGYM9MHTxlq4dLQLPyWsxWIYG5d9XqdSt691J9-n7uKwXR5HS7d3taOuWV-crPXDVHBQHtaou2A0RcOjQSiNnGIwZdXe3BtCrQSp9Hdw8iRmnUeOAAlww81VuHVkQoIQGJQVIMfcuwLSNAEqbycxhY0pgoJrP_jNTqnfc4jM_8Ox93rto77UehQ1vDBYGS2utT1efsJVXz2A5cqRKvjBYXkccI_pKOTFY6vm9H7y4Z-FfKbfCjxMLBUyVXOTlb8kbxchPn5wcJzWa7rTheGVUtGFK3HZH8Zem_u_mYeEnAAD__ziWZ3U) for selecting a running mate "is a strong leader who will make a great President for eight years after (Trump's) next four-year term concludes." Sources familiar with the selection process have indicated that some top contenders include North Dakota Governor Doug Burgum, Ohio Senator J.D. Vance, and Florida Senator Marco Rubio.
## U.S. Olympics Team Tells France to Cool It
The U.S. Olympic team will bring their [own air conditioning units](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LHO2yAUxfGnwRsWvmDAA0MXb-na0SJwndwKgwUkVt6-Sudv-0lnONL_z227eUqUH7_9ga7vZfOh0xs3zUFxUJsaotsRAeWAbjLTAtKYWQ9PF-9C7kZGj0JblN561Mssg1xwjhbtQA4EKKFBTQImsYw-gt1nAKWNNUvcmRIYqZc6_i2U-xP39ClvrGMox5Dcs_ezMfmLwcpgva5rzPeQ8WrfncH6JYO1naX2L16Nl_Q5Tgq8oz8av1fKD-4Df2XqjZ--UuM1ZD_NVk3zUF08L0qJmjZMicfhKf3_7j-XeDv4FwAA__-fAmFp) to Paris, despite French plans to reduce carbon emissions by using cooling pipes and fans to keep temperatures below 80 degrees. This decision undermines the [sustainability initiatives](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0DFurDAQANDTmA5kD4O9FC5-Q7e_TYm8eAwTGVjZI1By-kipc4InvY_n_Ayc-Vj_h528pHMOi_BFs20BW8AZm-gTEVDfkDfOjNA7N9hm8xoJKZp-6aNGG51eRhdHg2FI1hC5hj1oQG0BjQajxy5EeKQBAK17uDEmhZoiy1m6z5MP2Sjlr_Oi0i3n3mS_ibyr6v8pmBRM9313fFSOJButYafavfhbwRSK8JKpKpiMwWFEVDC9Q-Hahv3FwufRroXooCptCgvVNsiWSag2xcf3zTlztU6hXvfA-VeXvy8uDz8BAAD__-OwYdY) championed by Paris Mayor Anne Hidalgo, as AC use is uncommon in Europe, with less than 10% of Paris households equipped with units. Nonetheless, the U.S. Olympic and Paralympic Committee [emphasized the necessity](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLEOnDAQRL8GukVmMRgKF2noLm1K5IPl2MjYyF5A9_cRUcp0M5rRaPR-vaaXY8_h89PtZGWNk5uFL5o6QA2oJ10udiVCakqytakHbIxpu3Kzel5wQHL9-z209YCmGYxr6l61rW66VZVsUaFWHepaYa2Gyi3Yry2i7kxvhmUttKKFJabqd-QgG63-Gy9K1Rz30ttN5MhF86PAscDxvu_qPuR6wgLHfMQkucAx-u9-8PzIM8M_B1E2SiDk9gw3ew_vxOEDshEniHcAN8MZWDJIhMMlznCGhdJ8ijxFChenGHYK4jwc3oUy2eV4pjh3ptDqszv2f5_K_7ldFv8EAAD__7vsc6k) of air conditioning for athlete performance amid growing worries about extreme heat during the July games.

| | | Manhattan prosecutors are urging the NY judge overseeing Trump's criminal case to keep his gag order in place, given the danger he presents. And we agree 100%. (source)_ The danger is real, and Trump has shown no interest in changing his ways. He earned the gag order, and he deserves to have it kept in place. On Message
from Michael B. Moore
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
Welcome to our campaign newsletter.
We're using this space to keep you updated on all the latest stories, events, and opportunities related to Michael's run for South Carolina's 1st Congressional District.
Stay tuned — we'll be in your inbox every Monday.
See you on the trail.
Join our movement [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
On the calendar
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP50/1/104585/images/XXX_3.jpg]
Last Wednesday, on Juneteenth [https://www.facebook.com/MichaelBMooreforCongress/posts/pfbid02Uf8MD1SGU125Cse5Aj2zUFLtsn4ia3Qgcit45VuHRGT1hAkrHZH3MsZ2FNFuNNZ6l] , we celebrated the rights of all people to Life, Liberty and the pursuit of Happiness.
Let's continue the fight to safeguard our fundamental freedoms — and rededicate ourselves to the hard work of creating a more perfect Union.
In the news
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
Michael spoke with The Arena [https://www.facebook.com/MichaelBMooreforCongress/posts/pfbid01Qe92vjL3uC8tnZxA66gn61jFLRRBbkEjPcyYm2o5XXGEVyuHhxrLwwC79aVbNwyl] about what comes next for our general election campaign!
Our grassroots movement is hard at work energizing Lowcountry Democrats, persuading independent-minded Republicans, and assembling the coalition needed to defeat Nancy Mace in November.
In the arena
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
Michael called out Nancy Mace [https://www.facebook.com/MichaelBMooreforCongress/videos/822480999498508] for saying the women of SC-01 should head "somewhere else" to seek critical reproductive health care.
Unlike Mace, Michael believes reproductive freedom is a fundamental right — not something that should be left up to extreme Republican state lawmakers.
From the trail
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
We had a nice time visiting with the Sun City Democrats [https://www.facebook.com/MichaelBMooreforCongress/posts/pfbid028dTdkTxfEthb2mRRdVTrGBze4aiizdEinMn2wpWYWaFoQbqDyr4UCz94dpHdcMVyl] and all our friends in this special community!
In Congress, Michael will fight to bring down health care costs and protect Social Security. We can't allow Nancy Mace to pull the rug out from under our seniors in SC-01.
On our team
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/michael.b.moore-sc.1st-newsletter]
There's so much work to do, and we're only just getting started.
Join us in our fight to defeat Nancy Mace and flip this district.
Together, we're going to build a brighter future for South Carolina.

[](http://links.hungcaoforva.com/u/click?_t=c514f30bd6cd4b1bb0e09a0456675c53&_m=f1f456bb6c7d4faf8167605493ab7930&_e=u2wpdPBQ8mKpzuJNQo2OYciPimJENXZqdvLnteTeqQF0X7GZbjaAVGn3zVZptoiZ_TpkjdgJFIpIli9GlRg33-U6R6hKrhR1vJpxoRt6Ce5oUdOkSjodMVVAgJuXEP6Wg8oP_uPmlxTHT9_Vt6nDyHaEkNjFKZiCInc4gjFQ-abq58wZCQCcpIDtoIxqmLPpDKJDr_pPozQSZx6oMhEIH3p2Vnxn4KOGU46szgvBVNMWIaZ9gcDbtcMfgfq199mTmyzrvqPgmCIBf5DmVnK6Pd74ioK_v88trCP7LbZrGItwDHm7JJ30PwVolEL7Wo30Ub09nATRsCqa7W7_CaA56pg2W-icZAh9H9gd9vWCfno%3D)

## **I’m Telling you FIRST: I’m releasing a new book.**
---

# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1572%2E135344%2ECsZTkx)

Good morning.
As you might have guessed by the uptick in emails lately, I am about to ask you to make a contribution to my Senate campaign before our FEC deadline ends. As you may know from past end-of-quarter FEC deadlines, candidates are legally required to disclose all of their fundraising at the end of every three month period.
Our next quarterly FEC deadline is June 30th, after which we will file a public fundraising report detailing how much we raised and how many contributions we received.
But this is no ordinary FEC deadline, so please give me a chance to explain:
This FEC fundraising deadline is not only the last full deadline before we find out our Republican opponent, but it is the last one before the Republican National Convention.
That's a big deal.
Because these conventions are a place where party leadership, candidates, and other stakeholders come together to establish their strategic priorities: what issues they will focus on, what issues they will focus on, what elections they need to win and where, and investments they're going to make in Senate races like ours.
And the FEC report we file will be one of the last things they see when they gather. In fact, it's due on the first day they gather.
File a weak report, and that can mean a lot more spending against us, making it more difficult to win. File a strong report, and maybe some will look elsewhere.
[**It's not just about the amount of money we raise, but the number of donations we receive sends a strong message as well. #
Friend of life,

As you read this email, a precious preborn baby is about to lose his or her life through abortion. Despite the end of _Roe v. Wade_ almost two years ago, abortion rates are _increasing_.

The daily death toll of abortion is 2,813 in the United States -- that's 117 abortions per hour, 1.9 per minute, and one every 31 seconds.

The U.S. Supreme Court didn't end abortion. Congress has refused to stop the spread of this killing. But you CAN do something right now that will help turn the tide and save lives.

Live Action has the content proven to change minds about abortion and save lives, but we need to reach mothers who are moments away from abortion, especially in the most pro-abortion states.

We cannot reach these mothers - and those who influence them - without the caring support of people like you who invest daily in ending abortion. **Specifically, we are looking for 25 pro-life people in your state to give just $50 today. Your gift will fund:**
* The creation and release of _Truth about Sex_ videos and resources to empower young women and men to discover their own dignity and make life-affirming, healthy choices
* The ability to reach pregnant mothers with the _Window to the Womb_ web app that brings the life-saving power of 3D fetal development imagery into their pockets, showing how the precious preborn child is growing, learning, and playing in the womb.
* Providing local pregnancy centers with tangible support like diapers while mobilizing pro-life people to end abortion in their communities.

We cannot rely on someone else getting involved to help end abortion. It is up to us to lean in, invest, and save lives.

Here's your secure link to make your gift and help save a baby: **[https://give.liveaction.org/your-gift-will-save-lives-from-abortion/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=a0830522a5844c2cbde957663ca3938b&_e=vPomBSZK3-VJBTGIomPBec_-O0KTfFUPOo_Bo6_fWPE91CnFUZANuaC6_COqlO18KpQwB4jz_ilDNEYVzTNZ9EZWwnbjlIr7G_R7wRvldEOGeiHhGPhv6OZlqMD0N_9pcVVU0Vdqzx9pybpFopA2NgrcKB6ORym-CDAM5t3mJAnd7D4lUl8_MovC4ZWFB0ClOKGLaz41YEumXGW4C-XYjwQbfi9_xnCs6oPWdV_hgJzaPsule8bgCiEyD66wg0xCIsVGXZuuRXhQ6bIwSgCCdRjZ3P29J4qCffGYesZ3kER_Ofe1q_PFuKqAXXMLx3Oi4dDxc4EG2DQ1ADjBd_cO6TlpWH_GEd3UVtkVF8Za-Dv_PIBkXKsOU8BolgyDV06jZSqhgnv8LjMDxBoyDyEJnMvwPOAtjbCrkZ94QAGizsY%3D)**

Thank you for speaking for those who cannot speak for themselves.

For Life,

Lila Rose
**President and Founder**

[Last week](https://substack.com/redirect/275b8380-64ad-40db-b8df-5bc9d2371531?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) I asked my city council to divest from Israel's war crimes in Gaza, and received several angry emails in response.
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2550223&post_id=145833747&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ1ODMzNzQ3LCJpYXQiOjE3MTkyMzQzOTgsImV4cCI6MTcyMTgyNjM5OCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTI1NTAyMjMiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.kRd8JSF4PvnPh_Jj-2rjF9CcSfrv6fpquAIz4uVF0RI)
One critic emailed the below objections, and pretty thoroughly captured the majority of complaints of those who oppose divestment. The reader, let's call her Karen, emailed me this:
> Interesting idea but when will you mention that it was Hamas that began the conflict by attacking and killing over 1200 civilians? Do you consider this a war crime? Do you mention that Hamas has been responsible for continuing the conflict by still holding innocent civilians as hostages? I might also ask about Hamas stealing the food and medical supplies supplied by Israel from it's own citizens? And where are the civilians who still believe that Hamas is the answer to all their problems? Perhaps they are living in the tunnels? I then ask you, sir, "do you not have any decency" in reporting with honesty?
There is a lot to unpack here, but I feel compelled to do some unpacking. So, to clarify the facts at hand and stop the preventable murder of a single more person, I take this moment to thoroughly debunk the misinformation plaguing the Israel/Gaza dialogue. I break down Karen's email into her four main objections, and debunk each one by one--with plenty of receipts. **Let 's Address This.**
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..xKbci2u8k_6s17Hs9YrXoh1w9nzK0PVKuZJNk8TYYXM?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=145833747)
**CLAIM 1: Interesting idea but when will you mention that it was Hamas that began the conflict by attacking and killing over 1200 civilians? Do you consider this a war crime? **
On October 7 I publicly condemned Hamas' attacks on Israeli civilians as an act of terrorism. I [wrote](https://substack.com/redirect/280bdfa2-1dd4-466c-a148-6e835ffae92d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> I stand by what I've long said. Attacks on civilians are never justified. Hamas terrorist attacks, which have killed 200 Israeli civilians, are condemnable, inexcusable, and horrific. My deepest condolences to the loved ones of those lost.
Today we know those attacks killed 1200 people, but in the early hours after the attack I made my position clear, that such attacks against civilians are never justified. Likewise just two days later on October 9 I reaffirmed that Hamas' attack is a war crime when I [wrote](https://substack.com/redirect/4007ca9b-6b21-48b4-a65e-4d1c4d77ab05?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> Our standard is international human rights law, which holds that Hamas' war crimes are illegal, and Israel responding to war crimes with more war crimes is also illegal.
But the main crux of Karen's claim was that "_it was Hamas that began the conflict_." This is, of course, proven patently false with a cursory look at history. Israel's illegal military occupation of Palestinian territories began in June 1967, while Hamas was not founded until 1987. Hamas is, by definition, a reaction to 20 years of Israel's illegal and violent military occupation. Moreover, to allege this violence began on 10/7 is to also ignore the nearly 700,00 illegal settlements Israel has built on Palestinian land in the decades prior. Indeed, Israel yet [continues to announce thousands of new illegal settlements](https://substack.com/redirect/55239345-ce0b-4a23-a016-5dc2d105ee63?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Moreover, just in the year prior to 10/7, the Israeli military killed more than 250 Palestinian civilians, and [detained thousands more in indefinite detention](https://substack.com/redirect/7f7d2aeb-e041-4a53-9ad3-ad20adca92dc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) without charge, trial, due process, or access to counsel. This includes [up to 1000 children](https://substack.com/redirect/5d12a8c3-7bf4-4713-bf96-e0e5dc71018e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), according to B'Tselem, an Israeli human rights organization. In my view, none of this justifies 10/7, it does make clear that 10/7 was not the start of this violence.
And finally, new reports indicate that Israeli intelligence knew the details of Hamas' attack well in advance, including when, where, and how many hostages they'd take--[and did nothing to stop the attack](https://substack.com/redirect/04911432-a645-4d62-bdae-01170faf44fe?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). And now, the Israeli Supreme Court is preventing publication of the investigation to figure out why the Israeli government refused to stop the attack. Where is the accountability and transparency from the 'only' Democracy in the Middle East?
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..xKbci2u8k_6s17Hs9YrXoh1w9nzK0PVKuZJNk8TYYXM?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=145833747)
**CLAIM 2: Do you mention that Hamas has been responsible for continuing the conflict by still holding innocent civilians as hostages? **
I find this claim remarkable for two reasons.
First, because Netanyahu is on record as recently as June 23 confirming [that he will not abide by the UN Security Council resolution that his own war cabinet agreed to](https://substack.com/redirect/64160fbe-9875-4db0-9e32-48ce64e0dbe8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), that mandates release of all hostages and complete ceasefire. He's the blockade to the hostage release, and he admits this without hesitation.
Next, because the people claiming they care about hostages tend to ignore the pleas of the families of the hostages themselves. I share the words of the former spokesperson for the families of hostages, Haim Rubinstein. In a Times of Israel interview, Rubinstein lamented that the Israeli government "absolutely ignored" them, and [after an October 26 meeting with Netanyahu he felt particularly disappointed](https://substack.com/redirect/da50b7a1-834f-4af3-bc50-86f550604f6c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) because the return of hostages was not the Israeli government's priority:
> We left the meeting very disappointed because Netanyahu talked about dismantling Hamas as the goal of the war. He didn't promise anything regarding the demand to return the hostages. name: Jay Jones
subject: Why I'm supporting Planned Parenthood today
body:
www.jayjones.com [www.jayjones.com]
Friend,
On this second anniversary of Dobbs , I promise you that I will continue to advocate tirelessly over the years ahead that we enshrine a woman's right to choose in Virginia's constitution.
While last November's election results in Virginia were a resounding victory for choice, we know that we face another resounding test this November's Federal elections.
No matter what, our priority remains the same: to protect access to essential, time-sensitive sexual and reproductive healthcare. Part of how we accomplish that is by supporting our community partners on the front lines of reproductive healthcare.
That is why I’m reaching out to you today on behalf of Virginia League for Planned Parenthood (VLPP) to ask that we stand together to ensure continued access to affordable, high quality reproductive healthcare and elect pro-choice leaders this November.
Please join me by supporting the Virginia League for Planned Parenthood today! [https://www.weareplannedparenthood.org/onlineactions/cOJVhOyrzkq4uBcxVekXFA2?sourceid=1000065&affiliateID=091750&_gl=1*1jkdawd*_ga*MTQyNjAwMDg1NS4xNjI0MzAxMDYx*_gid*MjAyNzA2Nzg3Ny4xNjk5NTQ2MzA1]
I believe that every individual’s personal decision about their own reproductive health should be respected and valued.
Thanks for fighting with me.
- Jay

name: Tina Smith
subject: A somber anniversary
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Tina Smith for Minnesota
body:
|
#
Today is a somber anniversary, folks. Two years ago today, the Supreme Court confirmed what we expected after the opinion was leaked: **abortion rights are no longer protected._Roe v. Wade_ is no longer the law of the land.** We’ve felt the catastrophic impacts of this decision ever since. Across the country, millions of women have lost the fundamental right to seek an abortion. Right-wing legislators took this decision as an opportunity to further restrict reproductive rights. In Texas, abortion providers can be sued. In Alabama, a court’s ruling led to a pause in in-vitro fertilization (IVF). The list goes on. **Frankly, I’ve been devastated by the constant attacks on women’s freedoms. That the Supreme Court, full of justices appointed by Donald Trump and Mitch McConnell, has deprived women nationwide of abortion rights is unacceptable.** I’ve turned this pain and sadness into purpose and action in the Senate. My Democratic colleagues and I have introduced legislation to protect abortion access, medication abortion, IVF, birth control, and more — because while the right-wing attacks on women’s health continue, we need to step up. When the Dobbs decision first came out two years ago, I wrote, “We must stay strong together, we must organize, and I’ll be right there on the front lines with you. With _Roe_ gone, the most important thing we can do right now is to protect and expand our Senate majority. If we organize, work hard, and stop Mitch McConnell from flipping the Senate, we will have a chance to expand the Supreme Court, abolish the filibuster, and codify the right to an abortion into federal law.” **I’m still in this fight, and I know you are too.** **[Please, help me keep up this vital work to protect women’s healthcare by pitching in today. [](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/53028?refcode=em20240624-5844&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=5844%2E614464%2EyqMo7-)

**Lucas Kunce defended our freedoms for 13 years as a U.S. Marine, and now he’s ready to take that fight to the U.S. Senate.**

body:
2 years ago, SCOTUS overturned Roe v. Wade. The fight is not over, but 2024 continues to be one of the most crucial elections for reproductive freedom in American history.
| | | | | |
---
**2 Years After Dobbs**
---
| | | | Two years after the Supreme Court's Dobbs decision overturned Roe v. Wade, the future of abortion in the U.S. remains unclear and highly contentious. This ruling has led to widespread legislative action, protests, and lawsuits, and the impact has already been felt across the nation. Currently, abortion is banned at all stages in 14 Republican-controlled states, with three others restricting it after about six weeks. Most Democratic-led states, however, have enacted measures to protect abortion rights and support out-of-state patients. These restrictions have made accessing abortion more difficult and costly for many in conservative states, prompting significant out-of-state travel for care. Despite these barriers, the overall number of abortions in the U.S. has not decreased. Medication abortions are on the rise, often facilitated through telehealth and mailed to patients in states with bans by providers in states with protective laws. The legality of these practices remains hotly contested. As we approach the 2024 election, protecting reproductive freedom is more critical than ever. Democrats are fighting to safeguard access, while MAGA Republicans, led by former President Trump, aim to impose restrictions nationwide. Abortion-related measures will be on ballots in several states, further showing the issue's significance in this election cycle. [**_It is crucial that we defend reproductive rights in 2024 to prevent MAGA and the Republicans from stripping away these freedoms in all 50 states. Peter – **today is the second anniversary of the Supreme Court's Dobbs decision, which overturned _Roe v. Wade_ and the right to abortion nationwide.**
This decision – and the subsequent cruel and dangerous Republican laws put in place since – have created health care chaos for women across the country. But somehow, the nightmare women are facing to have control over their bodies and lives is not enough for the GOP.
They are coming after access to IVF and birth control – and trying to force doctors to refuse lifesaving medical care. Republicans have been threatening women who have a miscarriage with jail time, or even trying to punish anyone who helps someone travel out of state for abortion care. It seems like every single day, there is another horrible, anti-abortion law Republicans are pushing with no end in sight.
And we know with certainty that if given the chance, **Republicans will stop at NOTHING to pass a national abortion ban.**
If we can expand our Democratic Senate majority this November, we can and we will stop the GOP from passing a national abortion ban and restore the federal right to abortion. **That's why I'm counting on supporters like you to help ensure our blue Senate firewall outlasts the GOP's anti-abortion extremism at the ballot box this fall.**

The fight for full reproductive rights is far from over.
| | |
---
June 24, 2022, was a dark day for America, friend. Two years ago today, the Supreme Court ruled to overturn Roe v. Wade and struck down the constitutional right to abortion.
**But the fight for reproductive rights didn't start with Dobbs, and it didn't end there either – not for me. I have always been clear about where I stand.**
In fact, when I asked my wife, Connie, out on our first date back in 2003, she had just one thing she needed to know before she would say yes: my voting record on reproductive rights and LGBTQ+ rights. Both had to be 100% – otherwise, no date.

Here we are, more than 20 years after we went on that date, and I'm still fighting harder than ever.
**[But this isn't a fight that any one person can win alone, friend. I need your help to keep up the fight for reproductive rights in the Senate. So please, will you chip in $5 or even $25 now to help me beat my MAGA opponent, Bernie Moreno, who would proudly be the 51st vote for a national abortion ban?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87484184/481296432/691330008?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk2037-fr-nd&recurring=1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MmM1OWZiYi0zMjMyLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=lgPW1yB1hVb6hmyjvEIgVRp1TkNJw-nacChC_xMqxP4=)**

| | | **
CITIZEN TESTIMONY ALERT!
NEVER BE FORCED TO MASK AGAIN!
WE NEED 10 MINS. OF YOUR TIME!
SIMPLE INSTRUCTIONS HERE!**

---
|
Ohio House Bill (HB) 617 is explained as "Protect individuals from being compelled to wear a mask." on the State of Ohio, House of Representatives, web pages. It is important legislation to ensure we NEVER have to face government mandates forcing Ohioans to wear masks ever again. We need as many written testimonies as possible! Testimonies can be a short paragraph or up to two pages! Just make your VOICE HEARD! To see the bill & register to track it on the Ohio House website, click [**HERE**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=7238775181&e=5c740fa3e2).

Go [**HERE**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=1eafaa9ef8&e=5c740fa3e2) for simple instructions on what to do to give your personal testimony in support of this bill, or click on the image below. It can be done in 10 mins. or less!
######
---
| [ ](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=51208e9d97&e=5c740fa3e2)
---
|
---
| |
**THE OHIO PRECINCT STRATEGY
UNDERSTAND IT!
EMBRACE IT!
BECOME PART OF IT!**

---
|
If you haven't heard of the "Precinct Strategy" it is imperative you learn what it is and how it can be a big part of taking back our country, state, and communities from corrupt political insiders.

Ohio's political parties have an organization, codified in the Ohio Revised Code (ORC), that provides for 88 county parties and 1 state party for each of the 2 major political parties (Republican & Democrat).

Every precinct (or in some counties every ward & township) has an elected, unpaid, representative on their County Central Committee (CCC). These are the lowest-level elected offices in America, and a great way for average Americans to have an impact on how we are governed. All politics truly is local, right down to the precinct level. And the time commitment is typically no more than a few hours a calendar quarter.

The Ohio Precinct Strategy was formed to help Ohioans understand Ohio's political structure and identify grassroots candidates to run for these seats. The only qualification you need is to be an Ohio registered voter.

May 2026, about 2 years from now, is when more than half of Ohio's counties will have central committee elections.

If you have even a single spark of interest (or know someone else who might) please go to (or have them go to):

[**https://www.ohioprecinctstrategy.org**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=48b7558a57&e=5c740fa3e2)

Or, click on the image below!

There, you (or they) can register, find more information on filing to run, how to run and win, and what you can do once in office. We also have people across the state who can provide any help & information you might need.

If you have any questions, feel free to call or text **Mark Pukita** at **614-499-0599 (c)** and have a chat. You can email him too: [**mark@mark4ohio.com**](mailto:mark@mark4ohio.com)

THANK YOU!
---

**KEEP AMERICA FOR AMERICANS!
CHINA'S SILENT WAR ON AMERICA!
WEEK 4 • LESSON 4**

---
|
In May we sent out a one-time special message about a new initiative called "[**America for Americans**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=a93b22c543&e=5c740fa3e2)" designed to wake up more Ohioans to the threat China poses to our communities, state, and nation. If you haven't seen that message, you can access a copy of it on the web [**HERE**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=7417c0a100&e=5c740fa3e2).

Part of this initiative is an Ohio-developed, 10-week "course" titled “**China’s Silent War on America** ”. A lesson will be released every week for 10 weeks. To remind you, we'll highlight new lessons in this email. Last week we highlighted [**Lesson 4**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=df713b3ee0&e=5c740fa3e2). This week, we're highlighting [**Lesson 5**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=31cd7c4dc2&e=5c740fa3e2): **China’s Drug War on America[.](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=77b51061ce&e=5c740fa3e2)**

[**America for Americans**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=7397597d21&e=5c740fa3e2) will provide a short lesson, one a week for ten weeks, to educate us on the many strategies China is using to undermine America’s power at home and abroad, while enriching its own homeland. The reader will also be guided towards action items to help reduce China’s influence in the state of Ohio.

name: Gabby Giffords
subject: I never could have imagined this

body:
The progress we’ve made in our movement for gun safety the past eleven years gives me so much hope
#

Friends -
When I founded GIFFORDS eleven years ago, I could never have imagined that we would be able to build the gun safety movement we have today.
Back then, it was considered too divisive for politicians to even mention the words “gun safety.” Today, we endorse hundreds of candidates each election cycle who run on a gun safety platform. And they’re winning. In 2022, over 80% of our endorsed candidates won their elections.
We have passed over 600 gun safety laws in states nationwide since our founding. The two year anniversary of the passage of the _Bipartisan Safer Communities Act_ is tomorrow. This was the most significant federal gun safety legislation passed in nearly 30 years.
All of this progress gives me so much hope, and I hope it makes you feel the same way.
But there’s still so much work we must do. Over 120 people die from gun violence each day in America. Innocent lives stolen too soon by preventable acts of violence.
The only way we can continue in our work to end gun violence is through the support of people like you—people who care about keeping our communities safe from gun violence.

name: River Gassen
subject: River's Community Currents
body:
See where we’ve been these past two weeks | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/riverforcolorado/rivers-community-currents-8324358?e=3818d77efc)
---
| |
---
| |
#### 06/24/2024
Dear family and supporters, Tomorrow is the day! Yet we are still chasing ballots.

We are counting down the hours! This email should hit your inbox 34 hours from the closing of the polls. If you haven't turned in your ballot yet - what are you waiting for? Do it now! Find a drop box or go vote in person.

I voted! And I reached out to everyone I know. I am asking that you all do the same. Reach out to your neighbors, your co-workers, your friends, and your family, and make sure they have turned in their ballot!

My team has been busy this past week - hitting nearly 2000 doors in the last seven days. We are doing more right now too (while you're reading this email), and we plan to do more this evening and tomorrow.

Want to know who in your neighborhood hasn't voted yet? If you are interested in getting a list and want to drop off some literature of ours, respond to this email with your address and we will get you a list!

We've also been getting out the vote in our community - see where I've been this past week, and where I've been asking for votes!
---
|
---
|
---
---
| Juneteenth Jams
We went to Panorama Park and supported local Black artists for spoken word. Juneteenth is about Freedom and uplifting the Black community. It was great seeing so many powerful members of our community!
So many people we met there also told me they voted for me and voted early! It's so good to see so many early voters and so many active community members.
---
|
---
|
---
---
| Centennial Plaza Tenants Association
Betty Field has done some amazing work advocating for the rights of elderly people, disabled people, renters, and everyone else in need of a voice - ensuring dignity and respect for those who are often forgotten about. I was able to meet with her and her friends at the Centennial Plaza Apartment. It was great to see such a strong bonded community fighting for each other. I will fight for them too.
---
|
---
|
---
---
| Support Local Business - Pop
Our district is home to some of the best local food stops. This week I was able to take a break and head over to Pop, in Old Colorado City. Their staff is friendly and the food was amazing! I recommend the Trout platter.
---
|
---
|
---
---
| Group Canvassing and Picnic
The El Paso County Dems have a full slate of candidates - this election season is a busy one for us and we must work together to ensure we hit all the doors we need to. How nice that our state party chair was able to stop by too!
---
|
---
|
---
---
| Fountain Pride
Fountain Colorado must never be forgotten about - and I was ecstatic to attend their pride event this last weekend. Let's work together to elevate our voices!
---
|
---
|
---
---
| | | Celebrating Recent Endorsements* Thank you Betty Field, for our most recent endorsement heading into the election tomorrow.

See who is supporting us heading into the closing of the polls.

*Mom's Demand Action - Gun Sense Candide is a Distinction
---
|
---
---
|
---
---
|
---
| **More to Come: Watch Party** Join us tomorrow for the election watch party in Manitou Springs. Respond to this email directly to request information.
---
|
---
| **More to Come: Town Hall** Yes - we went ahead and scheduled our first town hall post-primaries.
Don't worry, I still plan on taking a break. I will be deep in the Rockies from June 28th - July 1st, but we will be hitting the ground running when I get back on the 2nd.

Issues don't become less important based on election results, the voices of our community need to be heard. This event will take place regardless of tomorrow's outcome - however, we certainly expect this to be our first post-primaries event.
---
|
---
|
---
| Final Thoughts of the Week Today and tomorrow will be all about getting out the vote! We are talking to Democrats and Unaffiliated voters, but we need to reach those who are not presently voting on our ticket. We need to reach voters, who don't necessarily vote down the ballot.

The sad reality about primaries is that you spend time securing votes that are already secured for November. We are also spending time, volunteer energy, and resources that we will need to replenish fast in the 5 months that follow.

I have learned a lot over the past few months, and am now more prepared for the general. During this primary - we have grown our team, our volunteer force, and got name recognition in commercials, flyers, yard signs, text, emails, and more. But the time has come for us to now shift our focus and amplify our efforts. This is why all donations made by you today - will be promised to the general election for the 5th Congressional District of Colorado.

Donations today and tomorrow (and of course any day after) will be used to fight the Republicans.
We will fight till the end to ensure it's a Democrat representing this district instead. This is my promise to you, with your donations today! Sincerely, River Gassen - Democratic Candidate for Colorado’s 5th Congressional District
---

body:
Thank you for taking action
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/87488971/481309779/664783965?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMGFjYjI2Ny0zYTMyLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=m98wzz87MBUJGNkw9vzK_GhnIJiZXrDCmDOeYfZqfMU=&emci=1c438393-fe2f-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=d0acb267-3a32-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=864787)
Hi Peter,
On the 12th anniversary of Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals (DACA), President Biden announced a historic executive order that will benefit nearly 500,000 undocumented spouses of U.S. citizens and shield them **from deportation, work authorization, and pathway to citizenship.**
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/87488974/481309787/-1691135242?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMGFjYjI2Ny0zYTMyLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=m98wzz87MBUJGNkw9vzK_GhnIJiZXrDCmDOeYfZqfMU=&emci=1c438393-fe2f-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=d0acb267-3a32-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=864787)
Undocumented spouses, many of whom are care workers, domestic workers, and unpaid caregivers, are integral to our country. They are valued members of our community and deserve to live without the threat of separation and deportation.
[**_Our partner organization the National Domestic Workers Alliance released a statement from President Ai-jen Poo on this executive action, which you can read here:_**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/87488979/481309800/-1691135242?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMGFjYjI2Ny0zYTMyLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=m98wzz87MBUJGNkw9vzK_GhnIJiZXrDCmDOeYfZqfMU=&emci=1c438393-fe2f-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=d0acb267-3a32-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=864787)
[READ MORE](https://click.everyaction.com/k/87488988/481309815/-1691135242?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMGFjYjI2Ny0zYTMyLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=m98wzz87MBUJGNkw9vzK_GhnIJiZXrDCmDOeYfZqfMU=&emci=1c438393-fe2f-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=d0acb267-3a32-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=864787)
In battleground states such as Nevada, Arizona, and Georgia, immigration is a critical issue for voters. Extending protections to the hundreds of thousands of undocumented spouses, including care workers and caregivers, marks a significant step forward.
This win was made possible by the endless organizing from our partner organizations, Black and brown women voters that continue to put front and center our undocumented communities.
[**_Read National Domestic Workers Alliance President Ai-jen Poo’s statement on this executive action:_**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/87489000/481309827/-1691135242?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNV08vMS83NjczNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMGFjYjI2Ny0zYTMyLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=m98wzz87MBUJGNkw9vzK_GhnIJiZXrDCmDOeYfZqfMU=&emci=1c438393-fe2f-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=d0acb267-3a32-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=864787)

body:
I’ve got a lot of crazy stories from my time as a beat cop, detective, then unit commander in the NYPD...

| |

---
| | | | [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z7rdcgena937fqdvo7tfn180cq9mso0f4mt0rcug_rp22sh2s8i6ep34s9imaor2c1h2bs "Alison Esposito")
---

Hey there.

I'll never forget the day I borrowed my mother's fur coat to go undercover as a prostitute.

It was a sting operation and I was a plainclothes officer.

I've got a lot of crazy stories from my time as a beat cop, detective, then precinct commander in the NYPD...

I saw my city go up in flames during the 2020 riots. I served on the SWAT rescue team. And I watched cashless bail and soft-on-crime policies decimate my city.

**My name 's Alison Esposito. After 25 years on the force, I retired from the NYPD to be Lee Zeldin's running mate when he ran for New York Governor in 2022. **

And we nearly pulled off the unthinkable in that race.

Since then, my life has taken a turn. I'm now running for Congress in one of the most closely watched races in the country. Many folks are saying whatever happens here will determine who controls the House Majority this time next year.

It's a 50/50, as-close-as-it-gets, true toss-up race in New York.

_**[So I'm teaming up with my friend, Steve Scalise, to help deliver this seat for the GOP, defend our Conservative House Majority, and save our country from soft-on-crime Democrats (like my opponent).](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z3jdjfskldgforep1fnjmj7jbkes7t7kvqsan4qo_rp22sh2s8i6ep34s9imaor2c1h2bs "So I’m teaming up with my friend, Steve Scalise, to help deliver this seat for the GOP, defend our Conservative House Majority, and save our country from soft-on-crime Democrats \(like my opponent\).")**_

We set a goal of raising 250,000 bucks before the end of June - _that will go a LONG WAY toward winning major races and stopping the Democrats from barging back into power._

I sincerely hope you're willing to help us out. We both do.

Why? Because the Radical Left Democrats are unloading 16 million dollars worth of attack ads in New York City ALONE. They have another 100+ million dollars ready to unleash at the drop of a hat. **That is enough cash to wipe out every vulnerable Conservative in every key state - including me!**

Which is why we are urgently calling on you for support.

_**[If EVERY strong Conservative reading this email agrees to pitch in SOMETHING, we'll hit our goal, catch up to the Democrats, and have the resources to fight back and win!](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zjoe2d42fqaeg8kjsh9oihpb1ns3efpkvmb9bnd8_rp22sh2s8i6ep34s9imaor2c1h2bs "If EVERY strong Conservative reading this email agrees to pitch in SOMETHING, we’ll hit our goal, catch up to the Democrats, and have the resources to fight back and win! ")**_

So I ask you now: can you please make an important contribution right now before our final June deadline?

Regardless, thanks for all you do for our movement. It makes a huge difference.

Take care,

Alison Esposito

Peter, today marks two years since our country’s ultaconservative Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade. **Since this devastating decision, 21 states from coast to coast have either severely restricted or outright BANNED abortion. **
That's why victories for reproductive rights like the recent SCOTUS ruling to keep mifepristone on the market are so critical.
**Thanks to this ruling, people seeking reproductive care can continue to access this safe, effective, and critical medication. **It goes without saying that this SCOTUS decision is a sigh of relief and a big win for our reproductive freedoms – **a****nd while we should be celebrating, our fight is far from over.**
Conservatives in positions of power across the board are attacking reproductive rights, from abortion access to IVF treatment – even access to birth control. And with their sights set on a _nationwide_ abortion ban, we cannot afford to let our guards down.
As attorney general, I have always fought back against anti-abortionists and extremists across the board who seek to strip away our reproductive freedoms, both in New York and beyond. And as the future of our reproductive rights hangs in the balance amid constant threats, I refuse to sit idle.

body:
I’ve got a lot of crazy stories from my time as a beat cop, detective, then unit commander in the NYPD...

| |

---
| | | | [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z7c7i2cml83upqf1r4423ck2hhldj8lv7jelgluo_rp22sh2s8i6ep34s9im6pb2cph2bs "Alison Esposito")
---

Hey there.

I'll never forget the day I borrowed my mother's fur coat to go undercover as a prostitute.

It was a sting operation and I was a plainclothes officer.

I've got a lot of crazy stories from my time as a beat cop, detective, then precinct commander in the NYPD...

I saw my city go up in flames during the 2020 riots. I served on the SWAT rescue team. And I watched cashless bail and soft-on-crime policies decimate my city.

**My name 's Alison Esposito. After 25 years on the force, I retired from the NYPD to be Lee Zeldin's running mate when he ran for New York Governor in 2022. **

And we nearly pulled off the unthinkable in that race.

Since then, my life has taken a turn. I'm now running for Congress in one of the most closely watched races in the country. Many folks are saying whatever happens here will determine who controls the House Majority this time next year.

It's a 50/50, as-close-as-it-gets, true toss-up race in New York.

_**[So I'm teaming up with my friend, Steve Scalise, to help deliver this seat for the GOP, defend our Conservative House Majority, and save our country from soft-on-crime Democrats (like my opponent).](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zmo6rmtpksb1mql1fsdauiv3hffui7r7isvinl4o_rp22sh2s8i6ep34s9im6pb2cph2bs "So I’m teaming up with my friend, Steve Scalise, to help deliver this seat for the GOP, defend our Conservative House Majority, and save our country from soft-on-crime Democrats \(like my opponent\).")**_

We set a goal of raising 250,000 bucks before the end of June - _that will go a LONG WAY toward winning major races and stopping the Democrats from barging back into power._

I sincerely hope you're willing to help us out. We both do.

Why? Because the Radical Left Democrats are unloading 16 million dollars worth of attack ads in New York City ALONE. They have another 100+ million dollars ready to unleash at the drop of a hat. **That is enough cash to wipe out every vulnerable Conservative in every key state - including me!**

Which is why we are urgently calling on you for support.

_**[If EVERY strong Conservative reading this email agrees to pitch in SOMETHING, we'll hit our goal, catch up to the Democrats, and have the resources to fight back and win!](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zp0sadurq8epiibo2josatdj3ruvuccobge9jr28_rp22sh2s8i6ep34s9im6pb2cph2bs "If EVERY strong Conservative reading this email agrees to pitch in SOMETHING, we’ll hit our goal, catch up to the Democrats, and have the resources to fight back and win! So I ask you now: can you please make an important contribution right now before our final June deadline?

body:
Chair of popular suburban PAC purportedly focused on addressing the crime epidemic calls Trump "Poison" and "Disaster" in unhinged social media posts.

view in browser (https://mailchi.mp/dba2265d3400/exclusive-donald-trump-jr-draws-large-crowds-receives-lifetime-membership-10344646?e=1cb5fdae9e) | update preferences (https://illinoisreview.us14.list-manage.com/profile?u=811d47b3c0783e80274d515f7&id=1a5a561027&e=1cb5fdae9e&c=df68c21643) | unsubscribe (https://illinoisreview.us14.list-manage.com/unsubscribe?u=811d47b3c0783e80274d515f7&id=1a5a561027&t=b&e=1cb5fdae9e&c=df68c21643)
