https://www.bestdental.org/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=df68c21643-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

Dear Peter,

Happy Monday. My name is Scott Kaspar, General Counsel of Illinois Review, and I thought this was an interesting article that every pro-First Amendment and Second Amendment Illinoisan should see. I might be a lawyer – in fact, I'm a lawyer in Illinois (the State Bar of Abraham Lincoln), Iowa, Colorado, and California – but I take our God-given rights seriously. And when those who masquerade among our ranks pretend to be conservatives but refuse to get behind our Presidential Nominee Donald John Trump, the People need to know. And that is why we are delivering this message to the hundreds of thousands who subscribe to us – Thank YOU.
ALERT: Safe Suburbs PAC's Kevin Coyne Calls Trump "Poison," "Disaster," Say Most GOP Voters Don't Identify as Pro-2nd Amendment (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/safe-suburbs-pacs-kevin-coyne-calls-trump-poison-disaster-says-most-gop-voters-dont-identify-as-pro-2nd-amendment.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=df68c21643-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/safe-suburbs-pacs-kevin-coyne-calls-trump-poison-disaster-says-most-gop-voters-dont-identify-as-pro-2nd-amendment.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=df68c21643-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

By Illinois Review
Safe Suburbs USA PAC founder, Naperville Library Board Trustee and suburban real estate attorney Kevin Coyne, who supported Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis during the 2024 Republican presidential primary, had some harsh words for presumptive Republican nominee for president Donald Trump – calling the former president a “disaster,” and suggesting in a bizarre social media post that a majority of GOP voters don’t support the 2nd Amendment.
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/safe-suburbs-pacs-kevin-coyne-calls-trump-poison-disaster-says-most-gop-voters-dont-identify-as-pro-2nd-amendment.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=df68c21643-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/safe-suburbs-pacs-kevin-coyne-calls-trump-poison-disaster-says-most-gop-voters-dont-identify-as-pro-2nd-amendment.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=df68c21643-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
The Safe Suburbs USA PAC (https://safesuburbsusa.com/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=df68c21643-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) , which Coyne founded in 2021 “to promote public safety and the welfare of suburban residents,” raises money to support and endorse pro-law enforcement candidates. In 2022, the PAC received two donations totaling $5,500 (https://www.elections.il.gov/CampaignDisclosure/ContributionSearchByCommittees.aspx?txtCmteName=02aNhA5ZslgPm755Lmmj5QnRzWOWZpFvR8W%2bX6yc2ro%3d&ddlCmteNameSearchType=%2fOm8zAJ7f4ioTTB90BLGGijKP5NjRbIx&ddlVendorState=Ry707kcsXsM%3d&ddlContributionType=wOGh3QTPfKqV2YWjeRmjTeStk426RfVK&ddlState=Ry707kcsXsM%3d&ddlFiledDateTime=Ry707kcsXsM%3d&ddlFiledDateTimeThru=Ry707kcsXsM%3d&utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=df68c21643-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) from Illinois House GOP leader Jim Durkin – a friend and confidant of outgoing IL GOP chairman Don Tracy and infamous Never Trumper.

In November 2022, the day after the election, Durkin announced (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/01/breaking-house-gop-leader-jim-durkin-resigning-says-trump-republicans-2nd-amendment-and-pro-life-issues-dragged-gop-down-in-midterm-election.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=df68c21643-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) that he was resigning as House Minority Leader. During the midterm election, Durkin suffered embarrassing losses, giving House Democrats once again, supermajority control in the Illinois House. And just days before resigning from office, Durkin was the only Republican to join the Democrats, voting in favor of Democratic Gov. JB Pritzker’s unconstitutional assault weapons ban – a move that angered Republicans across the state.

In media interviews after announcing his resignation as House GOP leader, Durkin attempted to place all of the blame on former President Donald Trump, saying (https://www.chicagobusiness.com/politics/trump-blamed-illinois-gop-losses-house-gop-leader-jim-durkin?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=df68c21643-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) , “As long as we continue to say that we are the party of Trump and that we have to abide by the party principles in the platform, 100% we’re gonna continue down this path of losing.”

In February, during an interview with a local news publication favored (https://www.theillinoize.com/articles/suburban-republicans-plan-trump-problem?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=df68c21643-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) by Tracy, Coyne said, “In the suburbs, Trump is political poison. Anyone on the ballot is facing a huge uphill climb when you have that kind of disaster at the top [of the ticket].” Coyne went on in an attempt to further distance himself from Trump, and “remind people that all Republicans are not the same.”

Back in August, Coyne’s PAC posted on X a “post mugshot poll” – taking a shot at Trump, who had his mugshot taken earlier in the day in Fulton County, Georgia as part of disgraced District Attorney Fani Willis’ election fraud investigation. Trump dominated the poll, beating DeSantis by 35 points.
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/safe-suburbs-pacs-kevin-coyne-calls-trump-poison-disaster-says-most-gop-voters-dont-identify-as-pro-2nd-amendment.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=df68c21643-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/safe-suburbs-pacs-kevin-coyne-calls-trump-poison-disaster-says-most-gop-voters-dont-identify-as-pro-2nd-amendment.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=df68c21643-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
On Sunday, Safe Suburbs USA PAC posted on X slamming the grassroots Trump Republicans in Illinois who are gaining influence in the state and suggested that a majority of Republican voters are not pro-life or pro-2nd Amendment, writing,

“Once you cross 88, Trump isn’t popular even with Republicans and even a great many R voters don’t identify as either pro-Life or pro-2A. More embarrassing elections to come for the ILGOP if the plan is to run far Right candidates statewide or in the suburbs.”
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/safe-suburbs-pacs-kevin-coyne-calls-trump-poison-disaster-says-most-gop-voters-dont-identify-as-pro-2nd-amendment.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=df68c21643-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/safe-suburbs-pacs-kevin-coyne-calls-trump-poison-disaster-says-most-gop-voters-dont-identify-as-pro-2nd-amendment.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=df68c21643-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

The PAC has also taken aim and blamed the conservative base of the party for Tracy’s resignation, posting, “Let’s run far Right candidates in deep Blue State in which R voters are fleeing by the day and in which the GOP faces a 20 to 1 financial disparity. This strategy should work swimmingly...for Democrats!”
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/safe-suburbs-pacs-kevin-coyne-calls-trump-poison-disaster-says-most-gop-voters-dont-identify-as-pro-2nd-amendment.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=df68c21643-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/safe-suburbs-pacs-kevin-coyne-calls-trump-poison-disaster-says-most-gop-voters-dont-identify-as-pro-2nd-amendment.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=df68c21643-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
Several days ago, Tracy submitted his resignation (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/embattled-il-gop-chairman-don-tracy-resigns-effective-july-19-blames-rise-of-grassroots-leaves-behind-a-record-of-massive-gop-losses.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=df68c21643-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) as party chairman effective July 19th – blaming the rise of the “grassroots,” party infighting and the removal of state central committee member Mark Shaw as vice chairman of the party without “due process” as the embattled leader of the IL GOP presided over widespread and massive losses during his brief tenure as chairman.

Over a week ago, Vince Kolber, who served as chairman of the IL GOP Finance Committee, abruptly resigned (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/06/breaking-vince-kolber-who-votes-in-il-wi-resigns-as-il-gop-finance-chairman-blames-grassroots-for-his-downfall.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=df68c21643-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) in an angry letter to Tracy, just weeks after the influential conservative grassroots base of the Illinois Republican Party scored major victories during the GOP State Convention in Collinsville – and after two years of unflattering stories by this publication. Kolber, who is registered to vote in Illinois and Wisconsin, was still angry about losing his election at the state convention for national committeeman – after being eliminated in the first round to Mark Shaw, who faked a delegate badge, voted illegally and threatened to beat up a fellow state central committee member. During the first day of the convention, the Republican National Committeeman nominating committee voted 14-3 to keep Kolber on the ballot
despite failing to meet the candidacy requirements as outlined by the IL GOP’s own bylaws.

The Safe Suburbs USA PAC has just named the candidates the organization will be endorsing (https://safesuburbsusa.com/2024-endorsements/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=df68c21643-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) during the 2024 election cycle:

My name is Scott Kaspar, General Counsel of Illinois Review, and I thought this was an interesting article that every pro-First Amendment and Second Amendment Illinoisan should see. I might be a lawyer – in fact, I'm a lawyer in Illinois (the State Bar of Abraham Lincoln), Iowa, Colorado, and California – but I take our God-given rights seriously. And when those who masquerade among our ranks pretend to be conservatives but refuse to get behind our Presidential Nominee Donald John Trump, the People need to know. And that is why we are delivering this message to the hundreds of thousands who subscribe to us – Thank YOU. ALERT: Safe Suburbs PAC's Kevin Coyne Calls Trump "Poison," "Disaster," Say Most GOP Voters Don't Identify as Pro-2nd Amendment () By Illinois Review Safe Suburbs USA PAC founder, Naperville Library Board Trustee and suburban real estate attorney Kevin Coyne, who supported Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis during the 2024 Republican presidential primary, had some harsh words for presumptive Republican nominee for president Donald Trump – calling the former president a “disaster,” and suggesting in a bizarre social media post that a majority of GOP voters don’t support the 2nd Amendment. CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE () The Safe Suburbs USA PAC () , which Coyne founded in 2021 “to promote public safety and the welfare of suburban residents,” raises money to support and endorse pro-law enforcement candidates. In 2022, the PAC received two donations totaling $5,500 () from Illinois House GOP leader Jim Durkin – a friend and confidant of outgoing IL GOP chairman Don Tracy and infamous Never Trumper. In November 2022, the day after the election, Durkin announced () that he was resigning as House Minority Leader. During the midterm election, Durkin suffered embarrassing losses, giving House Democrats once again, supermajority control in the Illinois House. And just days before resigning from office, Durkin was the only Republican to join the Democrats, voting in favor of Democratic Gov. JB Pritzker’s unconstitutional assault weapons ban – a move that angered Republicans across the state. In media interviews after announcing his resignation as House GOP leader, Durkin attempted to place all of the blame on former President Donald Trump, saying () , “As long as we continue to say that we are the party of Trump and that we have to abide by the party principles in the platform, 100% we’re gonna continue down this path of losing.” In February, during an interview with a local news publication favored () by Tracy, Coyne said, “In the suburbs, Trump is political poison. Anyone on the ballot is facing a huge uphill climb when you have that kind of disaster at the top [of the ticket].” Coyne went on in an attempt to further distance himself from Trump, and “remind people that all Republicans are not the same.” Back in August, Coyne’s PAC posted on X a “post mugshot poll” – taking a shot at Trump, who had his mugshot taken earlier in the day in Fulton County, Georgia as part of disgraced District Attorney Fani Willis’ election fraud investigation. Trump dominated the poll, beating DeSantis by 35 points. CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE () On Sunday, Safe Suburbs USA PAC posted on X slamming the grassroots Trump Republicans in Illinois who are gaining influence in the state and suggested that a majority of Republican voters are not pro-life or pro-2nd Amendment, writing, “Once you cross 88, Trump isn’t popular even with Republicans and even a great many R voters don’t identify as either pro-Life or pro-2A. More embarrassing elections to come for the ILGOP if the plan is to run far Right candidates statewide or in the suburbs.” CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE () CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE () The PAC has also taken aim and blamed the conservative base of the party for Tracy’s resignation, posting, “Let’s run far Right candidates in deep Blue State in which R voters are fleeing by the day and in which the GOP faces a 20 to 1 financial disparity. This strategy should work swimmingly...for Democrats!” CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE () Several days ago, Tracy submitted his resignation () as party chairman effective July 19th – blaming the rise of the “grassroots,” party infighting and the removal of state central committee member Mark Shaw as vice chairman of the party without “due process” as the embattled leader of the IL GOP presided over widespread and massive losses during his brief tenure as chairman. Over a week ago, Vince Kolber, who served as chairman of the IL GOP Finance Committee, abruptly resigned () in an angry letter to Tracy, just weeks after the influential conservative grassroots base of the Illinois Republican Party scored major victories during the GOP State Convention in Collinsville – and after two years of unflattering stories by this publication. Kolber, who is registered to vote in Illinois and Wisconsin, was still angry about losing his election at the state convention for national committeeman – after being eliminated in the first round to Mark Shaw, who faked a delegate badge, voted illegally and threatened to beat up a fellow state central committee member. During the first day of the convention, the Republican National Committeeman nominating committee voted 14-3 to keep Kolber on the ballot despite failing to meet the candidacy requirements as outlined by the IL GOP’s own bylaws. The Safe Suburbs USA PAC has just named the candidates the organization will be endorsing () during the 2024 election cycle: Mary Cole for Lake County State’s Attorney Aaron Porter for State Representative, 81st District Gabby Shanahan for State Representative, 97th District Kenton Skarin for Appellate Court, 3rd District Jennifer Sanalitro for State Representative, 48th District Chuck Maher for Will County Executive Raquel Mitchell for Will County Recorder of Deeds Vince Logan for Will County Board, District 7 Cindy Cronin Cahill for DuPage County Board, District 1 Nicole La Ha Zwiercan for State Representative, 82nd District Patty Gustin for DuPage County Board, District 5 Baron Leacock for DuPage County Board, District 3 Nicole Prater for DuPage County Recorder Regan Deering for State Representative, 88th District Eric Weis for Kendall County State’s Attorney Joe Soto for DuPage County Board, District 6 Matt Prochaska for Kendall County Circuit Clerk Laura Hois for DuPage County Board, District 2 Dave Scriven-Young for Will County Board, District 10 Eileen O’Neil Burke for Cook County States Attorney Robert Berlin for DuPage County States Attorney James Glasgow for Will County States Attorney Jamie Mosser for Kane County States Attorney Dennis Reboletti for State Representative – District 45 Lance Bell for Kane County Board Chairman Martin McLaughlin for State Representative – District 52 Katie Dean-Schlottman for Illinois Senate – District 49 Heather Brown for Illinois Senate – District 25 Annette Corrigan for DuPage County Board – District 4 Patricia Bonk for State Representative – District 30 Tosi Ufodike for State Representative – District 51 Jeff Castle for DuPage County Forest Preserve – District 4 Coyne’s comments in the press and social media posts critical of Trump and the grassroots will not be well received by the influential base of the Illinois Republican Party. And Trump leads Biden in virtually every national poll and in key swing state races. CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE () Copyright © 2023 IR Media Corp., all rights reserved. subject: How important is religious liberty to you?
body:
I want to remind you of some things we’ve seen (and lived through) in recent years—which we never thought we’d see in our country...

This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/Ps3i5H5C_5LIac-gv7PzGQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRoXCeMP0SxaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L3JlbGlnaW91cy1saWJlcnR5LXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDEyNTNOMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXJlbGlnaW91c2xpYmVydHlzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtUk9OLTIwMjQwNjI0VwNzcGNCCmZ145J5ZhDqLqpSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/Ps3i5H5C_5LIac-gv7PzGQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRoXCeMP0SxaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L3JlbGlnaW91cy1saWJlcnR5LXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDEyNTNOMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXJlbGlnaW91c2xpYmVydHlzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtUk9OLTIwMjQwNjI0VwNzcGNCCmZ145J5ZhDqLqpSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/Ps3i5H5C_5LIac-gv7PzGQ~~/AARclAA~/RgRoXCeMP0SxaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L3JlbGlnaW91cy1saWJlcnR5LXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDEyNTNOMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXJlbGlnaW91c2xpYmVydHlzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9UEEtUk9OLTIwMjQwNjI0VwNzcGNCCmZ145J5ZhDqLqpSFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

| Restore Our Nation

Peter,

Today marks two years since The Supreme Court’s disastrous ruling in the _Dobbs v. Jackson Women’s Health Organization_ case that overturned _Roe v. Wade_. The consequences of striking down Roe have been numerous and far-reaching, creating barriers and confusion for women, families, and doctors.

The _Dobbs_ case started right here in Mississippi, propelled by our Attorney General to the nation’s highest court. My opponent, Senator Roger Wicker, celebrated the anti-choice ruling as a “massive triumph,” and just voted against protections from contraception in the Senate.

_Senator Wicker either doesn’t understand – or worse, doesn’t care – about the impacts of his actions on everyday people. If we want to create change, we need to change the people elected to represent us._

Safeguarding reproductive rights and codifying the protections that were granted under Roe into federal law is one of the biggest reasons I decided to run for the U.S. Senate. I’m committed to working across the aisle to ensure that every person can keep healthcare decisions between themselves and their doctors without the interference of politicians – but I can’t do it alone.

body:
The fact that my daughters would be living with fewer rights than I had made me furious, and it still does.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87496719/481327749/1433120897?refcode=email-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjAyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NDFjMGExNy00MjMyLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Gq5jAir2LEAZQpUjzDAEvF6pwomN6izw3NUNdBxN-_Q=) Two years ago today, the Supreme Court decided against the will of the American people and stripped millions of their reproductive freedom.

I remember when the decision came down. I sat down with my daughters to process the disastrous decision as a family. The fact that they’d now be living with fewer rights than I had made me furious, and it still does.

Then, I joined hundreds at a rally outraged by this blatant attack on our rights.

June 24, 2022 was a dark day, and I’m proud of the work we’ve done since then in Michigan to protect reproductive health care. In the State Senate, we successfully repealed Michigan’s extreme abortion ban, which had no exceptions for rape and incest, and we passed a law protecting IVF.

But the fight is far from over. MAGA extremists, including my opponent, are trying to take away our right to abortion nationwide, with no exceptions, including here in Michigan.

**[Not on our watch. I’m running for Congress to protect these freedoms we’ve fought for in Michigan and across the country. My MAGA Republican opponent supports a national abortion ban, so we can’t afford to lose this race. name: Hillsdale College via Freedom Liberty Report
subject: The Connection Between Faith and Freedom
body:
I want to remind you of some things we’ve seen (and lived through) in recent years—which we never thought we’d see in our country...

This sponsored message from Freedom Liberty Report is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyMkU9v3CAQxT8NvmHBgHF94LCS41OSVu2hR4vA2IvEHwtwqnz7atPdnnOdmfd-M_N-v6wvxgef9lcTUW-hrKWuyaxXH2jB4Heaso_7CgwkZYqCXHnnNOOTk7JDzUc-gRwVTN1VD_zNMvPNDuPGEVChmzhOaAY2WIPcdF7ffJgCyRVjkvWjk3YTCFJtAwhniWQmYGn9VhBdjia54N-wtI-CRy6ttzl2QV9bOyoRFwILgSUc_dWHUJ0J2KM7CSyfq_t8VnqX03qWd_y4CcRSLREz4zCIVwYSntll_j4_Pf0ioM4W15rPYpGI-Si5HmibT_u9FdH5MxIxYzQ-3IvWxMP4PREx_-fesQ_qv7mcGqZGxPzjQpfnn_TxjK5od_zxIfiqRiLZfjP_PLV9NZJ3DX8DAAD__2-NlfA) Dear Friend, You have been selected by Hillsdale College to represent your state in a **National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** The referendum will only take a few moments of your time. Before you complete it, I want to remind you of some things we've seen (and lived through) in recent years--which we never thought we'd see in our country...
* Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.

* Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

* The weaponizing of the Department of Justice and the FBI against Christian pro-life advocates who are defined as believing in “extremist ideologies” and having the potential for “domestic terrorism.”

* Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted.

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyMkU9v3CAQxT8NvmHBgHF94LCS41OSVu2hR4vA2IvEHwtwqnz7atPdnnOdmfd-M_N-v6wvxgef9lcTUW-hrKWuyaxXH2jB4Heaso_7CgwkZYqCXHnnNOOTk7JDzUc-gRwVTN1VD_zNMvPNDuPGEVChmzhOaAY2WIPcdF7ffJgCyRVjkvWjk3YTCFJtAwhniWQmYGn9VhBdjia54N-wtI-CRy6ttzl2QV9bOyoRFwILgSUc_dWHUJ0J2KM7CSyfq_t8VnqX03qWd_y4CcRSLREz4zCIVwYSntll_j4_Pf0ioM4W15rPYpGI-Si5HmibT_u9FdH5MxIxYzQ-3IvWxMP4PREx_-fesQ_qv7mcGqZGxPzjQpfnn_TxjK5od_zxIfiqRiLZfjP_PLV9NZJ3DX8DAAD__2-NlfA) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide.

After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](https://email.alert.freedomandlibertyreport.com/c/eJyMkU9v3CAQxT8NvmHBgHF94LCS41OSVu2hR4vA2IvEHwtwqnz7atPdnnOdmfd-M_N-v6wvxgef9lcTUW-hrKWuyaxXH2jB4Heaso_7CgwkZYqCXHnnNOOTk7JDzUc-gRwVTN1VD_zNMvPNDuPGEVChmzhOaAY2WIPcdF7ffJgCyRVjkvWjk3YTCFJtAwhniWQmYGn9VhBdjia54N-wtI-CRy6ttzl2QV9bOyoRFwILgSUc_dWHUJ0J2KM7CSyfq_t8VnqX03qWd_y4CcRSLREz4zCIVwYSntll_j4_Pf0ioM4W15rPYpGI-Si5HmibT_u9FdH5MxIxYzQ-3IvWxMP4PREx_-fesQ_qv7mcGqZGxPzjQpfnn_TxjK5od_zxIfiqRiLZfjP_PLV9NZJ3DX8DAAD__2-NlfA) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

| Freedom Liberty Report

* According to The Guttmacher Institute, despite the rise in abortion bans, the number of abortions actually increased in 2023, the first full year following the fall of _Roe_. _“This increase demonstrates that women continue to seek and obtain abortion care despite the drastic reduction in abortion access in many states.”_ **We’ve said it before, and we’ll say it again: banning abortion does not stop abortions. It only stops** _safe_** abortions.**
* According to NBC News, a study estimated that, since abortion bans were put into place, “nearly 520,000 rapes were associated with 64,565 pregnancies across 14 states, most of which had no exceptions that allowed for terminations of pregnancies that occurred as a result of rape.”
* Texas saw the highest numbers, which, according to the Houston Chronicle, had over 26,000 “rape-related pregnancies during the 16 months after the state outlawed all abortions, with no exceptions for survivors of rape or incest.”

**Women everywhere, but especially in red states, aren’t just being left behind – they’re being targeted.** We’ve conducted a deep analysis of the political landscape in many of the states with abortion bans and found that **if more resources were dedicated to helping pro-choice women get elected in red states, it _would_ be possible to get these laws changed, but we need your help.**

[**We are just as angry as we were two years ago, and we have no doubt that you are, too. We are working to chip away at the male majorities in the states where abortion bans have been written. name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: The catastrophic Dobbs decision
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
Today marks two years since the catastrophic Dobbs decision.
Two years since our rights were seized by the most corrupt Supreme Court in United States history.
But we will have our day. We _will_ tell our story. And we _will_ have the right to choose — **not just over our bodies, but at the ballot box too.**
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/29382?t=1&akid=6697%2E2526796%2E14tSFy)
**We all have our own story of choice**. Whether you have a child, whether you don’t, whether you struggle to or cannot conceive — every single one of us has our story of deciding what we want for our lives.
**I want to share with you my family's story of choice**.
When my mom was 26 years old, she had just recently moved from Puerto Rico to NYC shortly after marrying my dad.
Both of my parents grew up in extraordinary poverty. In The Bronx, they lived in a 1-bedroom apartment, and dreamed of building a life — a better life — and a family together one day.
One day, my mom walked into a Planned Parenthood for an exam. And the clinic worker pulled up an ultrasound to show her that she was, in fact, pregnant.
And it was in that clinic — looking at that screen, taking stock of everything before her and what she wanted — that my mom chose me.
**But it was _her_ choice**. Not a court’s. Not a lobbyist’s. Not a politician’s. It was hers.
Over 20 years later, **I then had my own story of choice**.
I was very blessed with a loving childhood. My family didn’t have a lot, but we had each other. But after years of my family working tirelessly, tragedy struck.
My dad was diagnosed with a very rare form of lung cancer when I was in high school. He didn’t smoke, and it confounded the doctors. And a few, short years later, he passed away.
Overnight, my mom became a single mother of two. We did the best we could, but without my dad, we couldn’t afford to keep our house much longer.
I started waitressing around this time to make ends meet. I could pick up double shifts and scrap as much as I could to do what I needed to do. And it was around this time that I experienced sexual assault.
I never told anyone. It was the biggest secret of my life. I was terrified, confused, disgusted, depressed. But I still clocked in every day, with a smile that working in hospitality demands.
But I was alone. I was completely alone. **And I was late**.
Absolutely overwhelmed, I went to the pharmacy to pick up a pregnancy test, and I pulled out the cash tips from my bag from the night before in order to pay for it.
With my hands shaking around the instructions and the stick, I took the test. And set the timer to 3 minutes. And those 3 minutes transformed my life.
Many of you have had to wait those 3 minutes. You know it transforms yours, too.
I was absolutely terrified at what lay before me. I was wrestling with the trauma of the event that led me to that place, just weeks prior, that I would not be ready to tell anyone about for years.
But most importantly in those 3 minutes, one crystal clear, beaming thought rang through: **Thank God I have a choice. I am _so grateful_ that I get to choose**.
After so much that was beyond my control — the medical bills for my dads cancer, losing our family house after losing him, the violation of my own consent — at least in this, _I had agency_.
And while I didn’t know what I would choose in that moment, I knew that the choice itself would be mine, and mine alone.
Not a court’s. Not a lobbyist’s. Not a politician’s. **And certainly not Donald Trump’s**.
When that 3 minute timer rang up, I pulled out that test. And it was negative. That was one choice that I did not end up having to make.
If I did, it would have been past the time of these 6-week abortion bans rolling across the country as we speak.
**But I did make one choice that day** : in those 3 minutes, I decided that for the rest of my life, I would stand up for reproductive freedom and justice for all people in this country.
I know, sadly due to the prevalence of assault, that there are many who have similar stories. Perhaps you haven’t even told anyone yet. And many may share entirely different ones.
**But the one thing that binds us today is the understanding that reproductive freedom is an inviolable human right**. And we must stop at nothing until it is established and codified as the law of the land.
The next battleground is in November. It’s in defeating Donald Trump and reelecting Joe Biden and Kamala Harris. **And we cannot stop there**.
It’s also in electing an overwhelmingly Democratic House and Senate. It’s in chasing corruption out of our courts and our politics. **And we will succeed**.
Every single one of us has our story of choice: of looking at a crossroads and deciding how we want to proceed; of taking control of our own lives.
Whether it’s contraception, IVF, abortion, family planning, or any or none of the above — _these are our essential freedoms that unlock agency over our lives_. And it is up to us to defend, restore, and codify them as the law of this land.
**They have given us no other choice but to win.**
In solidarity,
Alexandria

[](https://www.facebook.com/OcasioCortez/?t=2&akid=6697%2E2526796%2E14tSFy) | [](https://twitter.com/AOC?t=3&akid=6697%2E2526796%2E14tSFy) | [](https://www.instagram.com/aoc/?t=4&akid=6697%2E2526796%2E14tSFy)

But, if you'd like to receive fewer emails, [you can do so here](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/signup/receive-fewer-emails/). Government mandates forcing Christian churches to close while casinos, strip clubs, and drug dispensaries remained open.
Far-Left activists targeting Christian business owners, Christian teachers, and Christian coaches through litigation.

Christians in the workplace being forced to hide their faith while critical race theory and transgenderism are promoted. **That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Referendum on Religious Liberty.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of the American people on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including religious liberty. Friend, you can complete the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** by using the secure link below: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=e865d06922fc4f9a9b4265b0e7652d19&_e=W8BjopgJbQAWDxKXeumx21cTH3zAawGt5R6dp_SMMxsZ4FSlv9Gg2lJjXLw83AHO7R9MRJiPSOR1xpFIzH4ZOpwtPk2I6XR3HRxMByVnecXJl-e86U10mbnANVAkXftJ7Rz3gHHbUj52_yMMWGbbYhzFV-cFqgYt_GYHiBx4s8cL9I_Wy997XFWwAEA6wGtQ1dhC_Ot7TDqj1XJpUVnOQ6kWZFsb1BkSI5WEb0gXRJFIs-3k5-bBubYCPMe_BLzu4Ilg8DS_aYzVZmc1ThitKI5Z9L9yFlybRhvtA7p7JOBAVPGG5uONKybH70ChQO__AkhaSWHC2cCFlGhdSkWJLugonBY7vwMD6NjKM8SWOJ2UXcANuvrUEpu4Zslu9bHsfEB1NPfMTCKH2UkVBdOTsQ%3D%3D) Like the founders of our nation, the founders of Hillsdale College understood the essential connection between faith and freedom. **The College was founded in 1844 to offer "sound learning" in order to preserve "the inestimable blessings...of civil and religious liberty."** Yet today's ruling class mocks people of faith as "backward," "bigots," and even "Christo-fascists." Politicians like Barack Obama claim that people like you "get bitter" and "cling to guns or religion." These so-called elites are full of contempt for you and for Christianity and will not protect your civil and religious liberties. You and I know that religious liberty in America is under serious threat. But we can reverse course. **The first step is ...EDUCATION.** Today's government policies that threaten religious liberty were conceived and implemented by people deceived by far-Left propaganda in our K-12 schools, colleges, and universities. That's why a vital part of this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens the TRUTH about America's great heritage of religious liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Save Religious Liberty in America.** These efforts include: **Teaching nearly 1,600 undergraduate and graduate students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who bring their traditional faith with them as they join the fight to restore liberty and constitutional government in our country.
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.6 million homes and businesses ten times per year. Previous issues include "Inside the Transgender Empire" by Christopher F. Rufo, "The Most Important Decision in Life" by Bishop Robert Barron, and "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon.
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn on topics such as Christianity, the Constitution, American history, and free market economics. Several courses (including "The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives," "Ancient Christianity," and "C.S. Lewis on Christianity") consider the important connection between faith and liberty.
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide. After everything we've seen in recent years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few moments of your time. Your completed survey will help us to develop the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. Thanks to our generous donors, we remain true to our original mission, even as many other colleges and universities reject religious liberty and embrace radical and dangerous ideologies.** I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the **National Referendum on Religious Liberty** , which you can access at this secure link: [**https://lp.hillsdale.edu/religious-liberty-survey/**](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=e865d06922fc4f9a9b4265b0e7652d19&_e=W8BjopgJbQAWDxKXeumx21cTH3zAawGt5R6dp_SMMxsZ4FSlv9Gg2lJjXLw83AHO7R9MRJiPSOR1xpFIzH4ZOpwtPk2I6XR3HRxMByVnecXJl-e86U10mbnANVAkXftJ7Rz3gHHbUj52_yMMWGbbYhzFV-cFqgYt_GYHiBx4s8cL9I_Wy997XFWwAEA6wGtQ1dhC_Ot7TDqj1XJpUVnOQ6kWZFsb1BkSI5WEb0gXRJFIs-3k5-bBubYCPMe_BLzua7rPjOdEsMFrMMzLoVrUYgcaoYUNbdniVlDnAdQZLxxF9o6RYGbPJOrtZISCN3l0rFtNPZIi7tsbIEoI2QBxFrAoxe69YPEX17i8_sXr7VBnD6FC6NYYO03fJMKo09lSWCEmadfip0PCH82q3yv7YQ%3D%3D) Thank you for your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of religious liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

name: Ruben Gallego
subject: My decision to run for U.S. Senate
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fight for Progress PAC and not authorized by any candidate or any candidate's committee
body:
I got a few free minutes here. No calls, no meetings. It isn’t much, but...

| Peter, I got a few free minutes here. No calls, no meetings. I know that doesn’t sound like much, but with a newborn at home, chaos in Congress, and a campaign to run... trust me, it’s a gift.

And I know we send a lot of emails already, but I wanted to take a few of those minutes to tell you about why I decided to run for Senate in the first place. You are critical to our success, and I feel like I owe that much to you.

The truth is, when I jumped in this race I had no idea how things were going to go. I didn’t know if this was going to be a two-way race, a three-way race, a thirty-way race. We had no clue what things would look like at this point.

But things have changed. This race is locked in now, and Kari Lake is my opponent — someone way more interested in burning our democracy down than building it up. Someone who doesn’t care about unity or reaching across the aisle. She is in this for herself, and for Trump.

And if she wins, it will be an absolute nightmare for Arizona and the country. She’s dangerous. Really.

**She’s also been raising a ton of money lately, and that’s extremely concerning. There’s a real chance that she takes this Senate seat. The polls are incredibly close, and the pundits all say this is one of the most likely states in the country to flip.**

One of the biggest FEC deadlines of the entire campaign is right around the corner, and when it hits we’re going to be legally required to release our fundraising numbers.

If we’re going to defeat Kari Lake, hold on to the Senate, and defeat Donald Trump, I’m going to need a ton of support from people like you. We need to show a lot of our strength in this FEC report.

So, please:

[_**Can you split a $10 contribution between my campaign and Fight for Progress today? The amount really isn’t as important as the number of donations we receive. You are critical to our success, and I feel like I owe that much to you. The truth is, when I jumped in this race I had no idea how things were going to go. I didn’t know if this was going to be a two-way race, a three-way race, a thirty-way race. We had no clue what things would look like at this point. But things have changed. Hi Friend, it’s Sen. Brad Pfaff. Before I ask you to chip in to my reelection campaign [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pfaff-email?refcode=20240624_em_fr_b1_BP_NGP] , I wanted to acknowledge the significance of today’s date.
Today is the 2 year anniversary of the Dobbs decision.
In 2022, the Supreme Court made a landmark decision in the Dobbs case that overturned Roe v. Wade.
While extremists rejoiced, most of the country mourned what this meant for their rights.
Since then, Republican-controlled state governments all over the country have been forcing their restrictive agenda on our communities.
Unfortunately, Wisconsinites are not safe from their agenda.
Friend, our state already has one of our nation’s oldest abortion bans, originating in 1849.
Earlier this year, our Republican-controlled Assembly approved a bill that attempted to put in place a new, extreme ban on reproductive freedom..

ELIZABETH PANNILL FLETCHER FOR CONGRESS [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/82676/images/lizzie-reelect-logo-outlined.png]
It’s been two years since the Supreme Court issued its decision in Dobbs v. Jackson , overturning Roe v. Wade and undermining the health, dignity, and freedom of women across America.
For years, many of us warned that extreme politicians and groups wanted to overturn Roe , and urged people to vote accordingly—to think about protecting freedom to make our own choices when voting for people who write the laws and those who interpret them. For years, so many people discounted that position as unlikely or unthinkable. I can’t count the number of times people told me it just wouldn’t happen, or that the courts would never reverse Roe , even though they were already chipping away at the rights it afforded.
We know now that we must vote for people who will protect our freedom. We need to restore Roe —which we can do through legislation—and we need to prevent further attacks on our freedom. Because reversing Roe was not the end, it was just the beginning. And we see evidence of that here in Texas and across the country:

It’s a long and growing list, but we can do something about it. We can elect pro-choice leaders across Texas and the country who will fight to protect and restore our freedom. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe240624?refcode=lpfe240624]
The majority of Americans believe that decisions about reproductive health care should be made between patients and their care providers. People, not politicians. As do the majority of Texans.
The gap between public opinion and public policy speaks to fundamental dysfunction in our political system. But our political system also gives us important tools to fight back against the assault on our health and freedom. And that’s what we have to do now.
We must, must, must remember that we can and will make a difference. And I hope you’ll help make a difference today by considering a contribution to support our efforts to win our race in #TX07 and support pro-choice candidates on the ballot this year. **YAF is suing UCLA and will take them to court so that students can hear the truth about Hamas --the truth that their school is fighting to keep from them. **

| | Today marks two years since the three extremist, right-wing Supreme Court Justices handpicked by Trump led the Court to overturn Roe v. Wade in the _Dobbs_ decision. We've been living with the dangerous, disastrous aftermath ever since. Make no mistake: The last thing anybody needs in the exam room when making personal, intimate decisions about our bodies are judgmental politicians who want to dictate the outcome regardless of the health risks. Yet, that's exactly what's happening right now. We are seeing the very real and dangerous consequences across the country of taking away the right to safe and legal abortions. Across the country, MAGA Republicans have passed laws banning abortion, criminalizing providers, and restricting access to contraception. More than 1 in 3 women in America currently live under some form of abortion ban. Women are waiting longer for needed care, being turned away from emergency rooms, and, in some cases, being forced to travel hundreds of miles to get the reproductive care they need. **In Oregon, we've made it clear we will stand strong for the right to compassionate reproductive care.** That's how it should be across the country. The decision to have an abortion is one that should be made by you and only you – not by judges, not by MAGA politicians, and not by your ability to pay or the zip code you live in. **It's outrageous that MAGA Republicans continue to put lives at risk by playing partisan games to criminalize reproductive care.** Restoring and defending reproductive rights for all Americans is one of the reasons I'm so focused on holding the Senate Democratic Majority, flipping the House in 2024, and holding the White House. It's on all of us – members of Congress, medical professionals, advocates, and voters – to stand up against this nightmare vision of women forced to carry pregnancies to term against their will. Each one of us should have the freedom to live our lives without politicians forcing their way into our bedrooms and exam rooms. Hi Peter, Trisha here.
Not only is tomorrow Election Day , but today marks two years since the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade , taking away our federal right to abortion access.
Because of Roe , many people were able to receive life-saving health care, people like my mother.
Before I was born, when my parents lived in rural Sterling, my mother found out she was expecting, but it was an ectopic pregnancy, where the fetus grows outside the uterus. My mother and her doctor had little time to make the necessary decision to terminate that pregnancy and save her life. And then, a year later, I was born.
My family wouldn’t have existed in the same way without the right to health care, like abortion. I would likely not exist. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/uplift-trishacalvarese?refcode=x_062424_RememberingRoe]
Politicians like Lauren Boebert and Greg Lopez have promised to ban abortion access. They want to control private healthcare decisions. They want to compel doctors to violate their oaths. They will force women to die preventable deaths.
It’s already happening all across the country as state after state bans abortion.
This is on top of the maternal healthcare crisis, millions of Americans lost access to maternal healthcare, contributing to worsening maternity care deserts like we've seen here in CD-4. We should be expanding access to care.
Republicans are trying to come after other ways of building families – like IVF and birth control.
My opponent claims to be a defender of families. But he was arrested for kicking his then-pregnant wife down the stairs. He didn’t care much about families or the health of the fetus, then.
Like other forced-birth Republicans, he doesn’t care about women, he doesn’t care about anything but his own power.
The ability for families to prosper begins with a woman's right to choose. The government has no place in that decision.
Strong families depend on local and affordable access to reproductive care, maternal care, pre and post-natal, including compassionate miscarriage care, and mental health support, especially in rural communities that may have fewer options for care.
There is still time to vote. This election decides who gets to sit in Congress until November as well as the Democratic candidate who will go up against Lauren Boebert.
Stand with me in defending women's rights to make their own healthcare decisions—vote pro-choice for a future with me, where I will fight for freedom and autonomy for all. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/uplift-trishacalvarese?refcode=x_062424_RememberingRoe]

clean_body: [] Hi Peter, Trisha here. Not only is tomorrow Election Day , but today marks two years since the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade , taking away our federal right to abortion access. Because of Roe , many people were able to receive life-saving health care, people like my mother. Before I was born, when my parents lived in rural Sterling, my mother found out she was expecting, but it was an ectopic pregnancy, where the fetus grows outside the uterus. My mother and her doctor had little time to make the necessary decision to terminate that pregnancy and save her life. And then, a year later, I was born. My family wouldn’t have existed in the same way without the right to health care, like abortion. I would likely not exist. [] Politicians like Lauren Boebert and Greg Lopez have promised to ban abortion access. They want to control private healthcare decisions. They want to compel doctors to violate their oaths. They will force women to die preventable deaths. It’s already happening all across the country as state after state bans abortion. This is on top of the maternal healthcare crisis, millions of Americans lost access to maternal healthcare, contributing to worsening maternity care deserts like we've seen here in CD-4. We should be expanding access to care. Republicans are trying to come after other ways of building families – like IVF and birth control. My opponent claims to be a defender of families. But he was arrested for kicking his then-pregnant wife down the stairs. He didn’t care much about families or the health of the fetus, then. Like other forced-birth Republicans, he doesn’t care about women, he doesn’t care about anything but his own power. The ability for families to prosper begins with a woman's right to choose. The government has no place in that decision. Strong families depend on local and affordable access to reproductive care, maternal care, pre and post-natal, including compassionate miscarriage care, and mental health support, especially in rural communities that may have fewer options for care. There is still time to vote. This election decides who gets to sit in Congress until November as well as the Democratic candidate who will go up against Lauren Boebert. Stand with me in defending women's rights to make their own healthcare decisions—vote pro-choice for a future with me, where I will fight for freedom and autonomy for all. We HAVE to turn out in record numbers in November — there is literally too much at stake to sit this one out.

**_We know when we vote, we win._**

Hi there, it’s Monica, Raul’s wife. I think I speak for both my husband and myself in saying that as health care professionals, this day two years ago was devastating. **On June 24, 2022, the Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_** — threatening access to reproductive health care and abortion across the country. In the two years following the Court’s ruling, MAGA Republicans have perpetrated further assaults on women’s rights in red, blue, and swing states alike. Throughout my career as an emergency room nurse, I’ve never been more afraid for the future of reproductive health care in our country than I am now — especially now that I’m a mother to two daughters. But I couldn’t be prouder of my husband and the work he’s doing in Congress. Since day one of his time as CA-25’s Representative, he’s been fighting tirelessly to defend reproductive freedom and ensure that everyone has access to reproductive health care. I can promise you that Raul will never stop fighting to protect our rights and freedoms — but I can’t say the same for his anti-choice extremist opponent. **That’s why it’s so critical we keep CA-25 blue and keep him on the frontlines of the fight for our reproductive freedom.** [If you’re able, I would really appreciate it if you would contribute $10 or any amount to Raul’s campaign today. Friend — I’m a born-and-raised Missourian.

And if Josh Hawley had his way, my kids would not be alive today.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87507026/481363129/153506864?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4000-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ZjQyNTc2MC00ZjMyLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8_c-OGFyf9LdRKuvQJDkqeSV-BRMOVZcmidyqTxAfsA=)
I know that might sound dramatic, and this is a long email. **But if you give me just a couple minutes of your time to explain, I know you’ll agree —[ and I hope you’ll then split a donation of any amount to help Lucas Kunce and Jacky Rosen defeat Josh Hawley this November.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87507027/481363130/153506864?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4000-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ZjQyNTc2MC00ZjMyLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8_c-OGFyf9LdRKuvQJDkqeSV-BRMOVZcmidyqTxAfsA=)**

It might be easy to assume I’m talking about Hawley’s continued opposition to marriage equality. He even voted against it in 2022. While Josh Hawley does seem to care a lot about what happens in my bedroom, I’m actually not married — just gay.
While it’s safe to assume Hawley’s opposition to civil rights protections for gay Americans means he doesn’t want me to be a parent anyway, his assault on my right to build and raise a family has a lot more to do with reproductive freedom — something that matters to each and every one of you reading this.
Like many Americans — women, men, gay, straight — I had to rely on IVF to build my family. I’m so incredibly thankful for the doctors, donors, and rockstar surrogates who helped bring my kids into the world. Those women gave me life. They gave me the chance to have a family. And I will be forever indebted to them.
My son Ben was born in 2019, and my daughter Lucy was born in 2022 — just a few months before the Dobbs decision. As any parent with IVF kids can tell you, it isn’t easy. It’s expensive, takes time, and often fails. Fertilized embryos will almost inevitably be lost, and the costs associated with indefinite storage means extra embryos are almost always either donated to research, donated to family, or discarded. It’s an immense privilege to be able to build a family with IVF, when it should be a right.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87507029/481363133/153506864?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4000-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ZjQyNTc2MC00ZjMyLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8_c-OGFyf9LdRKuvQJDkqeSV-BRMOVZcmidyqTxAfsA=)
Now, two years after Dobbs, we’re living in an America that has less freedom than it did before — from a total abortion ban in Missouri and IVF shutdowns in Alabama, to “fetal personhood” laws (which Missouri also has) that threaten reproductive freedom in its entirety.
**And no U.S. Senator is more personally responsible for it than Josh Hawley — who is now up for his first election since everything changed.**
You might already know about Josh Hawley’s extreme anti-choice views and how he’s used his taxpayer-funded office to support his wife's legal work in the Dobbs case and in the case to ban the abortion pill nationwide — **[and if that’s reason enough for you to want to help Lucas Kunce defeat Hawley in November, then please make that split donation to help him get it done.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87507031/481363134/153506864?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4000-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ZjQyNTc2MC00ZjMyLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8_c-OGFyf9LdRKuvQJDkqeSV-BRMOVZcmidyqTxAfsA=)**

**But if you didn’t already know about Josh Hawley’s deep personal involvement in every single part of the nationwide assault on reproductive freedom, then keep reading.**
It all started when Hawley led the Hobby Lobby case in front of the Supreme Court, which gave employers the power to refuse coverage for birth control for their workers. He even said contraceptives _“may induce an abortion by preventing implantation of a fertilized egg”_ — which, to be clear, is not true or what an abortion is according to virtually every medical professional.
Once Hawley got to the U.S. Senate, he did everything he could to push his extreme anti-reproductive freedom agenda forward: Putting campaign donors as well as anti-IVF and anti-surrogacy extremists on our courts. Using his taxpayer-funded office to support his activist-lawyer wife's cases to overturn Roe, enacting Missouri’s total abortion ban, and even trying to ban the abortion pill nationwide. And sponsoring extreme “fetal personhood” bills at the national level.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87507033/481363136/153506864?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4000-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ZjQyNTc2MC00ZjMyLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8_c-OGFyf9LdRKuvQJDkqeSV-BRMOVZcmidyqTxAfsA=)
**Then, Hawley made it clearer than ever how he feels about IVF and our right to build a family: He voted against a bill to guarantee access to IVF and make it more affordable. His reason?**

**Hawley told the media the Right to IVF Act was really part of an “abortion agenda.”**

**I’m sorry, but that’s CRAZY.**
| | [CHIP IN TO FIGHT BACK](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87507034/481363137/153506864?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4000-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1ZjQyNTc2MC00ZjMyLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=8_c-OGFyf9LdRKuvQJDkqeSV-BRMOVZcmidyqTxAfsA=)

His ultimate goal here is obvious — Josh Hawley doesn’t just want Big Brother politicians like himself to control us in our bedrooms and our doctor’s offices. He wants to control OUR bodies, and even how we choose to build and raise OUR families.

Our plan works. | Friend, Here’s the bad news: the election is only 134 days away, and right now Donald Trump is essentially tied with Biden. The good news is we have a plan: We’ve collected over 200 video testimonials from former Trump voters who won’t support him again. Our testing indicates these videos are far more persuasive than run-of-the-mill political ads. We rigorously test these videos to determine which groups of people are most persuaded by which videos. Sometimes the results are surprising, but we go where the data takes us. We carefully target voters with only the ads that work. We know we can’t convince the hardcore Trump supporters, and that’s okay. We only need to change a few thousand minds in the right states. We’re targeting key swing states. Without these states, Trump can’t get the 270 electoral votes he needs to win the election. That’s our plan of attack. It succeeded in 2020 when we beat Trump and in 2022 when we beat his handpicked candidates up and down the ballot. Our strategy works. We just need your help to make sure we have the resources to reach these persuadable voters in those key swing states with our exhaustively tested messages. On this day, just two years ago, the Supreme Court made the decision to overturn Roe v. Wade , tragically upending nearly 50 years of federal protections for reproductive rights.
Over the last two years, we’ve seen the repercussions of this decision play out in Republican-controlled states across the country. GOP extremists have done everything in their power to strip away abortion rights, lifesaving healthcare and medication, and reproductive freedom.
In fact, since June 24, 2022, 14 states have banned abortion across the United States, and an additional six states have early gestational limits between 6 and 15 weeks LMP (last menstrual period). That means that women living in states where abortion is banned or severely restricted now must travel out of state — often incurring additional costs related to travel and loss of wages — or obtain medication abortion drugs from companies who ship the pills without requiring a clinician visit.
And it’s only getting worse.
As you know, t he anniversary of this decision holds a unique weight for me. My son, Joey, was conceived through IVF (in vitro fertilization), a process that was directly protected by Roe v. Wade . Without that protection, the miracle of becoming a father might not have been possible.

| | Today marks the second grim anniversary of _Dobbs v. Jackson_ , the ruling in which right-wing extremists on the Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_ and ripped reproductive health care and bodily autonomy away from millions of women across America. Over the past two years, we've continually seen the true horror of the far-right's crusade on women and the constitutional right to privacy:
* Women denied the health care they need in emergency rooms, putting their lives in danger
* Doctors fearing being persecuted for doing their job
* Women forced to flee states to receive abortion care
* Efforts to ban IVF, mifepristone, and basic birth control

And the list goes on. But as difficult as the last two years have been, they have also reaffirmed a fundamental truth: **the American people don't sit quietly when their rights are taken away.** We've seen record turnout in down-ballot races against anti-choice extremists and their agenda that is wildly out of step with what the American people want. We've even seen voters in "red" states such as Montana, Ohio, Kentucky, and Kansas defeat abortion bans or pass abortion protections. History and public opinion are on our side – and if we elect a Democratic House, Senate, and President this November, I know that our first order of business will be legislatively codifying federal abortion protections. While the fight ahead won't be easy, our cause is stronger than ever, and the path to victory _is_ possible. | | | | [View this email in your browser.](https://ckzq96gbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001O3mjk8xYHI5zONmEcBhLJ7g9l5Ld4orpQa8WTPc0P1qLOjR8wVv3zaAKmp_uNRAf_Rxg96M7ZJRsDl3UyZq6CvL_EkwnW0EMRf-JDJYH6Si04joJ-zJV2kaqOw3lbHmHIKr-ZsPc14Gbo3oslWRETw==&c=JofgrKKaTnDQdOI_MJHopicVxir8iAmYYJVQd2IYTdnzhBG00FDksA==&ch=bszqCRJzoas-TL82IIlxjR4C6rFkKGa1_D0Iwe7jk6QZX_sFC_tLlQ==)

Hi Friend,
I grew up in a family of farmers, so I always knew not to look back when you put your hand to the plow. It's like driving, which is pretty hard if you're only looking in the rearview mirror.
The last several years have felt a lot like looking in the rearview mirror. Back to a time when the government had the final say on our reproductive rights. Back to a time when the government rather than our doctors decided what medical treatments were allowed. Back to a time when a handful of elected men told women they couldn't make their own healthcare decisions.
Two years ago today, the Supreme Court adopted this rearview mirror approach when it overruled Roe v. Wade. And the results are about what you would expect if someone tried driving that way. We've crashed head-on into anti-women crusaders who have pushed through extreme laws on abortion and other reproductive healthcare treatments--laws that this country hadn't seen in half a century.
But the wreck isn't over yet. Far-right politicians, like my opponent John Carter, have proposed federal legislation that would define human life as beginning at conception without any protection for IVF -- a law that would not just ban abortion and several forms of birth control nationally, but would also subject all patients and doctors to crushing potential liability for IVF treatments.
When I challenged Carter's anti-IVF position three months ago, I heard from some supporters that he didn't really mean to ban IVF. But Republicans in Congress proved otherwise less than two weeks ago, when they joined together to block a bill that would have protected IVF and other fertility treatments.
If the Republicans are working so hard to keep IVF from being protected, and Republicans like John Carter are introducing legislation that would ban IVF, is there any doubt that they really mean to ban IVF?
I am the proud father of two sons, whose lives--and the years of memories and experiences I've shared with them--were possible only because of IVF. What business does John Carter have telling me they shouldn't have been born?
For women whose doctors inform them that their baby is not viable, and that an abortion is the only option to protect their lives and health, what business does John Carter have telling them no?
John Carter and his MAGA-extremist colleagues want to look back to a time before modern medical science--and before women and the rest of us had achieved so much with the help of modern medicine. But that time has passed, and good riddance. Now we need to keep driving forward.
And if I happen to check the rearview mirror, I want to see John Carter there--enjoying retiree life outside of Congress as the rest of us move forward.

In Missouri’s 1st congressional district, Cori Bush is the ONLY candidate we can count on to fight for reproductive rights. In her upcoming Democratic primary, she faces an AIPAC-backed challenger being propped up by a flood of donations from anti-abortion GOP megadonors — the same right-wing millionaires and billionaires who’ve supported Trump and other Republicans. Not only that, but he once served as the campaign manager of a conservative Republican who opposed abortion. [ ]HuffPost: Rep. Cori Bush’s Democratic Challenger Once Managed a GOP Congressional Campaign. In a Democratic wave year, Wesley Bell served as the campaign manager for a conservative Republican who was anti-abortion. Why should we believe he’ll defend abortion in Congress better than Cori? [ ]There are only a few weeks left until this critical, competitive primary election, and Cori is fighting an influx of AIPAC spending: will you split a donation between Justice Democrats and Cori’s campaign now to help re-elect her? [ ]Contribute $5 Cori knows firsthand the crucial importance of being able to make decisions about one’s own body, health, and family: in 2021, she courageously shared her personal story of getting an abortion after she was sexually assaulted as a teenager. In March, she became the first Democratic member of Congress to demand a repeal of the Comstock Act, an outdated 1873 ‘zombie law’ that Republicans are trying to use to ban abortion pills and procedures nationwide. Cori is the only true progressive Democrat in this race with the lived experience and track record of fighting for reproductive freedom and bodily autonomy. The man challenging her may say he’ll protect reproductive rights, but his donations and work history tell another story. Peter,
Two years ago, our conservative-stacked Supreme Court made the reckless decision of overturning Roe vs. Wade.
In Arizona and across our country, we’ve seen the real-world consequences of this decision.
If anti-choice Republicans had their way, Arizonans would be living under an 1864 abortion ban, criminalizing patients, along with their doctors, for providing abortion care.
We cannot and will not accept this as our new normal.
In 2019, I saw the true consequences of a full abortion ban during a visit to El Salvador as part of a delegation of state legislators. We met with women who had been incarcerated and women who had been prosecuted after experiencing obstetric emergencies, including miscarriages and stillbirths.
Here’s a news story from back then where I spoke about what I saw:

Now, the reality is that our fundamental rights and freedoms are being chipped away by MAGA extremists, and it’s our responsibility to fight back.
From my work with Planned Parenthood to my time as an organizer and a state legislator, I unapologetically believe that people and families deserve to make decisions over their own bodies, lives, and futures.
