Peter,
Today is the second anniversary of the right-wing Supreme Court’s decision to upend 50 years of legal precedent by overturning Roe v. Wade.
**For two years, COURIER’s network of local newsrooms has fearlessly covered the decision's awful impact on women and their families. **
Take a look:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87509135/481371146/-593472309?refcode=20240624-EM-DobbsAnniversary&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZjY4OTRjYjktNTMzMi1lZjExLTg2ZDItNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=p1HuAAvddQRdqDpbORTcH_UTpzXMQmpivBSOeV-Oyac=)
Women struggling to find basic reproductive health care. Doctors unable to do their jobs. Right-wing politicians at every level of government enacting dangerous restrictions on reproductive rights.
**These are the stories that matter right now, and we’re proud of our team for providing critical coverage during this perilous moment for women and their families. **
[**We’ll talk more about where the fight to restore reproductive is going in a moment, but if you want to support COURIER’s diligent reporting on reproductive rights in battleground states across the country, can you chip in $20?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87509136/481371149/-593472309?refcode=20240624-EM-DobbsAnniversary&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZjY4OTRjYjktNTMzMi1lZjExLTg2ZDItNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=p1HuAAvddQRdqDpbORTcH_UTpzXMQmpivBSOeV-Oyac=)
When it comes to abortion, Republicans want to use a little-known and currently unenforced law – The Comstock Act – to make it illegal to ship “anything designed, adapted, or intended for producing abortion” across state lines. **The new interpretation of the law would criminalize shipping abortion medications and potentially medical equipment. Distressingly, it would also apply in states where abortion is legal and even constitutionally protected.**
So that’s the bad news. The good news? **COURIER’s research-backed model can help stop it.**
In 2022, we ran an experiment in Michigan to measure how factual news stories about abortion rights could impact voting behavior on Michigan’s ballot initiative to enshrine reproductive rights into the state’s constitution.
**The results were promising to say the least:**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87509138/481371150/-593472309?refcode=20240624-EM-DobbsAnniversary&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZjY4OTRjYjktNTMzMi1lZjExLTg2ZDItNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=p1HuAAvddQRdqDpbORTcH_UTpzXMQmpivBSOeV-Oyac=)
Michiganders were more likely to oppose abortion bans after reading reports from _The Gander_ , our local Michigan newsroom.
**Peter, these results show the real impact our reporting can have on our elections.** With so much at stake this year, we need to get our work in front of as many voters as possible.
That’s where you come in. COURIER provides free, factual news on the issues that matter most, like the Republican fight to destroy reproductive rights post-Roe. We operate in eleven battleground states across the country, where our news will have the greatest impact.

Peter,

_Do you have a few minutes?_

I wanted to take a moment and personally share my story with a true patriot like you.

This is Greg Abbott here, Governor of the great state of Texas.

I was born in Wichita Falls, Texas, and was raised in Duncanville. Growing up, I was involved in various activities, including baseball, Boy Scouts, and track and field.
[](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=6fe443bd7a244d45af78edc55c1e4eee&_e=C5NMeZ9qm7vRhQXaDTS1LgjisJxBMu8IBlO4yYUeLArQuiLs5jD35PoMEovJXyasAEzvLEm-zv4muIFMfhNCKEKerGscNY6Mf98LUplpeuao7SE71Eeq-_PSOm66I5Buh42czCh9uNf0-sD_gpoFXMQpBWdNcxeltyWdoIg9q3xAMEzQJV3CnNh_SIgkH44Vn_iUGBiV6V3IZMiAFyarAA_ZWxPNMFc7iLU3Ihibmpc5SM_WT2baRFQ4N4r7OnWsDH44HN79_-IbasN3Oc9RIoV0-NwvvQK_0qlge7fQKxqnSGNaynYpCcpGw0dww4PdbnulXtIIzNMbp8gVa4YdKJCTedqTP5Zk8X3LPa16gv9L3xTnKygmEzg7yIYKATdUxXHDxbPbi2T94tighxt5dw%3D%3D)
Education has always been very important to me, so I decided to further my education after high school. I went on to attend the University of Texas at Austin and graduated with a B.B.A. in finance. Later on, I earned a law degree from Vanderbilt University.

In 1981, I proposed to the love of my life, Cecilia, on the San Antonio Riverwalk, and we got married later that year. It was the best decision I've ever made!
[](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=6fe443bd7a244d45af78edc55c1e4eee&_e=C5NMeZ9qm7vRhQXaDTS1LgjisJxBMu8IBlO4yYUeLArQuiLs5jD35PoMEovJXyasAEzvLEm-zv4muIFMfhNCKEKerGscNY6Mf98LUplpeuao7SE71Eeq-_PSOm66I5Buh42czCh9uNf0-sD_gpoFXMQpBWdNcxeltyWdoIg9q3xAMEzQJV3CnNh_SIgkH44Vn_iUGBiV6V3IZMiAFyarAA_ZWxPNMFc7iLU3Ihibmpc5SM_WT2baRFQ4N4r7OnWsiQr3Uy3Vciy0n8tHOlf1sn5A4FAwbnocP6TloQ2tHa6iNR5XCDQ3k5c02heaewPHp6rNLr-_36sxC5h4kDmOgT6lE8IZUaLOBaI2gfwSMFDuDsVWkh2s2tmPu0g2lfC-wWRVpoIrjlIeIaUDdMzJ5A%3D%3D)
Peter, everything changed in 1984. One day while I was out jogging, a tree fell on me and left me partially paralyzed. From that moment on, I knew my life would never be the same.
[](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=6fe443bd7a244d45af78edc55c1e4eee&_e=C5NMeZ9qm7vRhQXaDTS1LgjisJxBMu8IBlO4yYUeLArQuiLs5jD35PoMEovJXyasAEzvLEm-zv4muIFMfhNCKEKerGscNY6Mf98LUplpeuao7SE71Eeq-_PSOm66I5Buh42czCh9uNf0-sD_gpoFXMQpBWdNcxeltyWdoIg9q3xAMEzQJV3CnNh_SIgkH44Vn_iUGBiV6V3IZMiAFyarAA_ZWxPNMFc7iLU3Ihibmpc5SM_WT2baRFQ4N4r7OnWs5-DTwcF-Nk4i4ciqF_pmxy6XM047DYu8nsTpWXc00f11mwYzENQVD0idio2kZDpGoX96DTxw54pJCDC5kuXYn7LLJPNOOfAORLgx-dfG0DsTX_9MriR1Hibtor_9IvzPYdtEwCa2iH6JVwiVukvKsw%3D%3D)
From my faith and my family, I gained strength during this difficult time. I learned to recognize that our lives are not defined by our challenges but by how we respond to them. _And I chose not to let this accident break my spirit._

Instead, I turned to the Scripture passage _James 1:12_ , which got me through the most difficult season of my life. I had faith in God and trusted in his plan for me.
_**" Blessed is the man who remains steadfast under trial, for when he has stood the test, he will receive the crown of life, which God has promised to those who love him."
\- James 1:12**_
_Peter, during challenging moments in our lives, it 's important to remember what matters the most to us_. For me, it's my faith, my beautiful wife Cecilia, my amazing daughter Audrey, and of course, our three dogs, Peaches, Pancake, and Honey Butter Chicken Biscuit!
[](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=6fe443bd7a244d45af78edc55c1e4eee&_e=C5NMeZ9qm7vRhQXaDTS1LgjisJxBMu8IBlO4yYUeLArQuiLs5jD35PoMEovJXyasAEzvLEm-zv4muIFMfhNCKEKerGscNY6Mf98LUplpeuao7SE71Eeq-_PSOm66I5Buh42czCh9uNf0-sD_gpoFXMQpBWdNcxeltyWdoIg9q3xAMEzQJV3CnNh_SIgkH44Vn_iUGBiV6V3IZMiAFyarAA_ZWxPNMFc7iLU3Ihibmpc5SM_WT2baRFQ4N4r7OnWsC7H71tPypq98pXlt2uoin3xfkFRtg6-YD7YxkFhfi8OhzY87_HU12AZCReWL4F0ruGhH2uBCZUV5Acw1Ss6IUaHMquF-lgpIAOy_Net1KceorLu-jdMdXMZbB8NkHWIaVF3_VgjClsXrjqjImDqUtw%3D%3D)
I often say our lives are not defined by the obstacles we encounter but our response to those challenges. _This rings true for our state and its people, too. _

Under Joe Biden's administration, Texas and all of America face unprecedented challenges daily.
_**[Our southern border is overrun with dangerous criminals.

Our economy is sinking under skyrocketing inflation.

Parents are being denied school choice and freedom.](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=6fe443bd7a244d45af78edc55c1e4eee&_e=C5NMeZ9qm7vRhQXaDTS1LgjisJxBMu8IBlO4yYUeLArQuiLs5jD35PoMEovJXyasAEzvLEm-zv4muIFMfhNCKEKerGscNY6Mf98LUplpeuao7SE71Eeq-_PSOm66I5Buh42czCh9uNf0-sD_gpoFXMQpBWdNcxeltyWdoIg9q3xAMEzQJV3CnNh_SIgkH44Vn_iUGBiV6V3IZMiAFyarAA_ZWxPNMFc7iLU3Ihibmpc5SM_WT2baRFQ4N4r7OnWsucaPkE9gGJjmA-pBPgdPOsLbDatJaQXKVpsHQPsHs-0XPcctY3hpcjsUBTy2VqHrml5OWvNVeh3eUvdiroenCv7boTNoIg_YJDzea4DP4gQyk8eT1LYAmtgYIa74HnWk7B2A--kubRVxTxwA6FTaoA%3D%3D)**_
Peter, mark my words: I remain steadfast in my focus to build the Texas of tomorrow by making it brighter, safer, freer, and more prosperous. **[Stand with our movement here.>>](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=6fe443bd7a244d45af78edc55c1e4eee&_e=C5NMeZ9qm7vRhQXaDTS1LgjisJxBMu8IBlO4yYUeLArQuiLs5jD35PoMEovJXyasAEzvLEm-zv4muIFMfhNCKEKerGscNY6Mf98LUplpeuao7SE71Eeq-_PSOm66I5Buh42czCh9uNf0-sD_gpoFXMQpBWdNcxeltyWdoIg9q3xAMEzQJV3CnNh_SIgkH44Vn_iUGBiV6V3IZMiAFyarAA_ZWxPNMFc7iLU3Ihibmpc5SM_WT2baRFQ4N4r7OnWsG5vbZ67siwvr7tF03jRl74dkc9qZMTYoG7AIGzU-jRJoAs0Oh2d1_g5jQo_wrVCeG_Zwaxd6jZLbo_Nwn8CplEq2-RuAm-ffGmvShPD5KYwZqjKPUdxRUDC4-l5K5RugGaaq8L0g_yqYzSnVlr1j8w%3D%3D)**

clean_body: Wanted to share my life story with you. | | | | | | | Untitled Document Peter, Do you have a few minutes? I wanted to take a moment and personally share my story with a true patriot like you. This is Greg Abbott here, Governor of the great state of Texas. I was born in Wichita Falls, Texas, and was raised in Duncanville. Growing up, I was involved in various activities, including baseball, Boy Scouts, and track and field. Education has always been very important to me, so I decided to further my education after high school. I went on to attend the University of Texas at Austin and graduated with a B.B.A. in finance. Later on, I earned a law degree from Vanderbilt University. In 1981, I proposed to the love of my life, Cecilia, on the San Antonio Riverwalk, and we got married later that year. It was the best decision I've ever made! Peter, everything changed in 1984. One day while I was out jogging, a tree fell on me and left me partially paralyzed. From that moment on, I knew my life would never be the same. From my faith and my family, I gained strength during this difficult time. I learned to recognize that our lives are not defined by our challenges but by how we respond to them. And I chose not to let this accident break my spirit. Instead, I turned to the Scripture passage James 1:12 , which got me through the most difficult season of my life. I had faith in God and trusted in his plan for me. " Blessed is the man who remains steadfast under trial, for when he has stood the test, he will receive the crown of life, which God has promised to those who love him." \- James 1:12 Peter, during challenging moments in our lives, it 's important to remember what matters the most to us. For me, it's my faith, my beautiful wife Cecilia, my amazing daughter Audrey, and of course, our three dogs, Peaches, Pancake, and Honey Butter Chicken Biscuit! I often say our lives are not defined by the obstacles we encounter but our response to those challenges. This rings true for our state and its people, too. Under Joe Biden's administration, Texas and all of America face unprecedented challenges daily. Peter, mark my words: I remain steadfast in my focus to build the Texas of tomorrow by making it brighter, safer, freer, and more prosperous. | Peter,

At a recent event, a local businessman introduced me to a large crowd, explaining why he was supporting my campaign.

He mentioned my work in Congress, he named particular bills I’ve passed, he highlighted my work across party lines, and then he said something that garnered the greatest response from the audience — he said that he and his wife are expecting their first child — a daughter — and he wants her rights to be protected and he trusts me to do just that.

I’m reflecting on his words and the stories I’ve heard from people across Virginia and the country since the Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_ exactly two years ago today.

People of all ages who worry about the ongoing attacks on women’s rights and who fear that they or the women in their lives might someday not be able to receive the care they need because of continued attacks on our reproductive freedoms.

Tragically, we know their worry and fears are justified — because we’ve seen women in other states suffer as **attacks on our freedoms and state laws further restrict abortion access.**

**As the next Governor of Virginia, I will stand up to these attacks. I will defend our fundamental freedoms — including the right to choose, the right to privacy, and the right to contraception.**

But I can’t do this alone. **I need your support** to stop extreme politicians and judges from dictating the healthcare decisions women can make. Your support powers our efforts to protect and restore our rights.

| This week marks two years since the Supreme Court overturned the half-century precedent set by _Roe v. Wade._ Their decision to strip away bodily autonomy shocked and outraged many Americans, including myself.

Since then, Republicans nationwide have relentlessly attacked reproductive rights, passing bills that target abortion providers, criminalize women seeking abortions, and make reproductive healthcare even less accessible.

**I was proud to cast the first pro-choice vote in West Michigan history.** For the first time, our district is represented by someone who will always fight for your right to make your own healthcare decisions.

Two years since the overturn of _Roe v. Wade_ , my commitment to advocate for the equal rights of all people in West Michigan and to continue fighting for reproductive freedom remains steadfast. But to pass the much needed legislation codifying _Roe v. Wade_ , taking back the House majority is crucial.

## **Standing Up to the War On Women**
---
Hi Peter,Attacks on women and on public education are what drove me to leave the Republican party, and eventually to run for Congress.Today is the second anniversary of the Dobbs supreme court decision that overturned Roe v. Wade.That awful decision has now put my opponent Michael Cloud and other extreme politicians like him on a warpath to attack women’s rights to reproductive healthcare freedom. Cloud will say he supports “limited government” but nothing can be further from the truth when you have extreme politicians getting between women and their doctors at a time when difficult healthcare decisions are being made.Cloud has co-sponsored a bill that would ban abortion nationwide.Cloud has co-sponsored a bill that would ban In Vitro Fertilization nationwide. Meanwhile, Cloud is mostly focused on divisive political theater over delivering for our district.The good news – Michael Cloud is extreme, and he’s also a poor fundraiser. This makes TX-27 ripe to flip this November.Since this campaign started in January, I have driven over 16,000 miles to meet with folks across the 14 counties of this district. Everywhere I go, people want their reproductive freedoms back. If elected, my first order of business would be to work with my colleagues to enact the Women’s Health Protection Act, codifying Roe v. Wade into law. **We have a critical fundraising deadline at the end of this month** , so please chip in what you can to help fill up another tank of gas to support our campaign for reproductive freedom.

| | In this course you will learn Lewis's profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis 's The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis's Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis's beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis's own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

subject: I need to be frank with you, Peter
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY HILL HARPER FOR MICHIGAN
body:
And I’m humbly asking that you hear me out.
# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/421?t=1&akid=1280%2E62735%2ELvd8K5)
Hey Peter —
I know candidates far and wide are sending a lot of fundraising emails right now, asking for your support ahead of this weeks end-of-quarter fundraising deadline. It seems like everyone's clamoring for our attention and contributions these days.
To be completely honest, asking for your money is my least favorite part of running for office. But I do need to be frank with you about what’s at stake: **This FEC deadline is our campaign’s biggest test yet.**
After our fundraising numbers go public, ALL eyes will be on us to see if we have what it takes to win this high-stakes Senate race. We’re running an outsider campaign, and everyone will be looking for signs of weakness as we go head-to-head with the establishment.
**So I want you to know how grateful I am to have you by my side through my biggest challenge yet.**
You believe that a better future is possible — one where healthcare is a right, workers earn the wages they deserve, and our children receive the best possible education. You believe in putting _people_ first, not corporate interests. **And you know that real change starts from the ground up — not with the wealthy and powerful at the top.**
That’s why we aren’t funded by corporate PACs or beholden to special interests. Instead, we rely on the strength of our grassroots supporters to keep us going. Every contribution we receive right now will help us hire more field organizers, connect with more voters, and grow our movement into a winning campaign.
**[So, I'm humbly asking for your support ahead of Sunday's deadline, Peter. Please, chip in any amount that works for you to help hit our $25,000 end-of-quarter goal.](https://act.hillharper.com/go/1754?t=2&akid=1280%2E62735%2ELvd8K5)**

Dear Friend of Knowledge, Are you struggling with a difficult question in your life? Often, I find myself in that position as well. It's part of the human condition to be faced with difficult situations, choices, and people. We teach at Hillsdale College that we must carefully consider concepts such as morality, ethics, happiness, courage, character, and justice when we face difficult questions. In the _Nicomachean Ethics_ --the first book written on how best to live--Aristotle argues that human happiness chiefly depends upon a person's character, which is formed by making good choices. But good choices don't come naturally. That's why every student at Hillsdale studies Aristotle. In fact, understanding Aristotle is so important to living a good life that we've produced our online course, **" Introduction to Aristotle's _Ethics_ : How to Lead a Good Life." **
---
| | And now you can own the course on DVD, along with a special Hillsdale College edition of Aristotle's _Nicomachean Ethics_ , for personal study. You'll not only study what Aristotle says about the good life with Hillsdale College President Larry P. Arnn, but you will also explore ways to put this knowledge to work.

body:
I got a few free minutes here. No calls, no meetings. It isn’t much, but...
Friend, I got a few free minutes here. No calls, no meetings. I know that doesn’t sound like much, but with a newborn at home, chaos in Congress, and a campaign to run... trust me, it’s a gift.
And I know we send a lot of emails already, but I wanted to take a few of those minutes to tell you about why I decided to run for Senate in the first place. You are critical to our success, and I feel like I owe that much to you.
The truth is, when I jumped in this race I had no idea how things were going to go. I didn’t know if this was going to be a two-way race, a three-way race, a thirty-way race. We had no clue what things would look like at this point.
But things have changed. This race is locked in now, and Kari Lake is my opponent — someone way more interested in burning our democracy down than building it up. Someone who doesn’t care about unity, or reaching across the aisle. She is in this for herself, and for Trump.
And if she wins, it will be an absolute nightmare for Arizona and the country. She’s dangerous. Really.
**She’s also been raising a ton of money lately, and that’s extremely concerning. There’s a real chance that she takes this Senate seat. The polls are incredibly close, and the pundits all say this is one of the most likely states in the country to flip. **
One of the biggest FEC deadlines of the entire campaign is right around the corner, and when it hits we’re going to be legally required to release our fundraising numbers.
If we’re going to defeat Kari Lake, hold on to the Senate, and defeat Donald Trump, I’m going to need a ton of support from people like you. We need to show a lot of our strength in this FEC report.

I know that doesn’t sound like much, but with a newborn at home, chaos in Congress, and a campaign to run... trust me, it’s a gift. You are critical to our success, and I feel like I owe that much to you. The truth is, when I jumped in this race I had no idea how things were going to go. I didn’t know if this was going to be a two-way race, a three-way race, a thirty-way race. We had no clue what things would look like at this point. But things have changed. This race is locked in now, and Kari Lake is my opponent — someone way more interested in burning our democracy down than building it up. Hey there.

I'll never forget the day I borrowed my mother's fur coat to go undercover as a prostitute.

It was a sting operation and I was a plainclothes officer.

I've got a lot of crazy stories from my time as a beat cop, detective, then precinct commander in the NYPD...

I saw my city go up in flames during the 2020 riots. I served on the SWAT rescue team. And I watched cashless bail and soft-on-crime policies decimate my city.

**My name 's Alison Esposito. After 25 years on the force, I retired from the NYPD to be Lee Zeldin's running mate when he ran for New York Governor in 2022. **

And we nearly pulled off the unthinkable in that race.

Since then, my life has taken a turn. I'm now running for Congress in one of the most closely watched races in the country. Many folks are saying whatever happens here will determine who controls the House Majority this time next year.

It's a 50/50, as-close-as-it-gets, true toss-up race in New York.

_**[So I'm teaming up with my friend, Steve Scalise, to help deliver this seat for the GOP, defend our Conservative House Majority, and save our country from soft-on-crime Democrats (like my opponent).](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyUkbGK3DAQhp9G7mSksSzbhYuDw5DiwkGKlEJrzfoGbElo5L17_ODAVmly1RTDN_83_L_f3JunneL20x84E7Mr7OrD8ep3yZXiJlN2oMBIZSUYp5sw96DH-9jgrAc9QT_BoJqPeTT3-80oCDc_eLQwwTB6RGvGgOvgfUPzdUdZMHrSGnRrpv6G1gdzg6EH1Qmjzhx8xZYiU0BeU8o57VRp5TaVrdnnj1ozi-5FwCJgYVzPgu0nxYKhXdMhYKnoD3n5E6OA5ZopSuScmGq6uG4pF1cobqJ7reVEAfash1v9kT1tUXSvT1X3_iJ__HrXrdad7Yyruld9P01SD70VYPHLVQrfAP7mpFgx1iv8IYlZPmEB9uuMj38XTZlD_qR9J7aDMGo7PO3Xw039v9YeM_wJAAD__8Hvlws "So I’m teaming up with my friend, Steve Scalise, to help deliver this seat for the GOP, defend our Conservative House Majority, and save our country from soft-on-crime Democrats \(like my opponent\).")**_

We set a goal of raising 250,000 bucks before the end of June - _that will go a LONG WAY toward winning major races and stopping the Democrats from barging back into power._

I sincerely hope you're willing to help us out. We both do.

Why? Because the Radical Left Democrats are unloading 16 million dollars worth of attack ads in New York City ALONE. They have another 100+ million dollars ready to unleash at the drop of a hat. **That is enough cash to wipe out every vulnerable Conservative in every key state - including me!**

| Peter,

Today marks the second anniversary of the Supreme Court’s decision to overturn _Roe v. Wade._

The overturning of this landmark decision that protected abortion access as a constitutional right for decades had a devastating impact on millions of Americans. Since then, MAGA Republicans across the country have been demonizing people for seeking abortions.

The deadly GOP platform to punish people seeking abortion is not only dangerous, but has severe implications for access to reproductive care everywhere.

body:
https://jenaforcolorado.com [https://jenaforcolorado.com]
Peter –
It’s been two years since the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade , and the consequences for women across the country have been huge. Colorado continues to protect the right to reproductive freedom, and we continue to be a safe haven for women in surrounding states.
The Dobbs decision enabled states with anti-choice leaders to restrict abortion access. In this country right now, women are being made second-class citizens. Extremist elected officials are putting women's lives at risk, and even trying to throw women and doctors in jail.
We cannot allow this extremism to take us back decades. Abortion is health care, and we must protect it. The anniversary of this decision underlines just how important participating in our Democracy is. I am proud that Colorado has accessible elections where every eligible voter has multiple ways to cast their vote. Because, Peter, voting for pro-choice leaders is how we will continue to protect the right to bodily autonomy. The attacks on women’s bodies by far-right elected officials have gone on for too long.
You have my promise, as long as I have a say, I will never back down from protecting abortion access and women’s bodily autonomy.
In solidarity,
Jena Griswold

Happy Pride Month, friends!

Pride has always been a special time of year for myself and many others. It's a time when we can celebrate our love for one another with our community. But it’s also a time for us to pause and remember those who have fought for LGBTQ+ rights for decades, from the fight for marriage equality to the fight now for trans visibility and safety.

In our current political climate, extremist Republicans have made it a priority to spread hatred and fear against the LGBTQ+ community. This month, my Republican colleagues added an unnecessary anti-Drag amendment to our Defense bill all in an effort to limit expression and spread hatred and fear for the drag community. That does not roll with me. As long as I am in Congress, I will continue to defend the LGBTQ+ community.

Thank you,

Robert

Hi Peter, it’s Elyse, the daughter of Bob and Terese Casey.
This week marks two years since the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade.
Since then, 23 states have worked quietly and swiftly to pass laws restricting women’s reproductive rights -- including services like IVF.
I was only able to give birth to my two healthy boys because of IVF. After learning that I have a condition that makes it much more challenging to become pregnant naturally, I had no choice but to undergo numerous fertility treatments to become a mom. And, my dad was only able to become a grandfather because I had this unrestricted access to IVF.
I know the challenges many women and families across the country face when trying to start a family because I lived it. It is disturbing on a deeply personal level to witness Republican politicians' attempts to restrict women’s basic rights to fertility treatments like IVF.
The stakes of this election could not be higher. We need leaders like my dad who will continue to stand up for our basic rights in Washington every day. | Derek,

Two years ago, the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade, stripping away a fundamental right that had been protected at the federal level for half a century.

As your Governor, I've been fighting like hell every day since to protect and restore reproductive freedom in our state. We’ve made progress in this fight, but we aren’t out of the woods yet and I won’t stop until we fully repeal Wisconsin's archaic 1849 criminal abortion ban.

I’ll never back down when it comes to abortion rights

I will veto any bill that takes away reproductive freedom or makes reproductive health care any less accessible in Wisconsin than it is today.

We'll keep fighting until Republicans heed the will of the people, until every Wisconsinite has the right to make their own healthcare decisions, and until we guarantee our kids and grandkids won't grow up in a world where they have fewer rights than we did.

[**Will you stand with me and chip in $10 today to help us protect reproductive rights and flip the legislature this November?**](https://go.tonyevers.com/go/2257?t=5&akid=6768%2E1827488%2Ef2NIbF)

Together, we can ensure that reproductive health decisions remain between a patient and their doctor, not politicians or right-wing judges.

Thank you,

Tony Evers

subject: Voters Reminded that Scott Baugh Seeks Nationwide Ban on Abortion and IVF on the Anniversary of the Dobbs Decision
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/756633634579/voters-reminded-that-scott-baugh-seeks-nationwide-ban-on-abortion-and-ivf-on-the-anniversary-of-the-dobbs-decision-16198488?e=7017cc100e)
---
| |
---
| | **For Immediate Release:** June 24, 2024
**Contact:**[press@davemin.com](mailto:press@davemin.com)
**Voters Reminded that Scott Baugh Seeks Nationwide Ban on Abortion and IVF on the Anniversary of the Dobbs Decision**
**IRVINE, CA** — June 24th marks the second anniversary of the Supreme Court’s Dobbs decision, which overturned Roe v. Wade – ripping away the federal constitutional right to abortion, a right Americans held for nearly fifty years. Since then, House Republicans have continued to advance their ultimate goal of a national abortion ban, criminalizing birth control, and ending access to fertility treatments like IVF for people wanting to start or grow their families.

Meanwhile, **Republican Scott Baugh supports a complete ban on abortion and is working to make it illegal for women to have an abortion with no exceptions for rape or incest or to save a woman’s life**. Baugh even supported punishing doctors and gave tens of thousands of dollars to politicians trying to pass a bill that would essentially ban IVF and could threaten access to birth control. Baugh would put the government, not doctors, in charge of women’s medical decisions.

**“The Dobbs decision represents the worst of today’s Republican Party: it’s a blatant attempt to control women, enforced by a politically motivated Supreme Court,”** said State Senator Dave Min, the Democratic nominee in CA-47. **“In contrast, I co-authored California’s constitutional amendment that enshrined protections for reproductive freedom, including abortion care and contraception, authored the first-in-the-world law on reproductive coercion, and have a 100% rating from Planned Parenthood. The MAGA movement is not your parents’ GOP. Trump, Scott Baugh, and their allies are more concerned with control than freedom. We need to enshrine reproductive and contraceptive freedom in our Constitution, reign in the Supreme Court, and keep Scott Baugh far away from Washington.” **

By contrast, Baugh opposes abortion, with no exception for rape or incest, has long opposed marriage equality, and refuses to acknowledge the results of the 2020 presidential election as legitimate. He recently described the unanimous verdict of a jury made up of 12 average Americans finding Trump guilty of 34 felony convictions as a “political persecution.” Baugh has a checkered past that is out of touch with the district’s values. In 1996, Baugh faced more than 20 criminal charges, including four felonies, for violating campaign finance laws, perjury, and related charges. He also chaired the Orange County Republican Party even as they ran a fraudulent voter registration fiasco that resulted in 12 felony arrests. Baugh is not just mirroring Donald Trump on felony counts, but has also matched Trump on his extreme MAGA agenda. ###

_California’s 47th is an open Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Katie Porter is vacating the seat to run for U.S. Senate. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this “toss-up” district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15% in this area. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country. _

Friend,

Two years ago today, the Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_ , stripping millions of women of their right to reproductive freedom.

In the time since, we’ve seen how this ruling has instituted an unprecedented and unacceptable level of government control – and we’ve seen millions of Americans suffer under extreme abortion bans.

The government has no place in our personal healthcare decisions. **But my opponent has already committed to a national abortion ban that would strip women of their reproductive freedoms.**

**Our fundamental freedoms are on the chopping block. And if House Republicans are able to grow their Majority by flipping seats like OH-01 red, we can bet they’ll take that next step in passing a national abortion ban.**

Can I share something with you, folks?
Montana is the best state in the best country in the world. Here, your word is your bond, and a handshake still means something. You can count on your neighbors to help pull your car out of a ditch. You know your local postal workers by name and you share family recipes with the entire church congregation.
Growing up in Big Sky Country meant long drives, open skies, and plenty of mom and pop shops. It was a big deal when western Montana got its first escalator. Now, we have more than I can count on my fingers (which still isn’t many).
But wealthy outsiders like my opponent are trying to turn our state into a playground for the rich. They come into Montana, buy up luxury properties, and don’t give a damn about our way of doing things.
**As a third-generation Montana dirt farmer, these values are in my bones and come hell or high water, I’ll do whatever it takes to preserve our Montana way of life. This fight is personal to me.**
[**I’ll stop at nothing to defend our Montana way of life, I need you with me. If you can, please chip in a split donation between my campaign and The Long Run today. You can count on your neighbors to help pull your car out of a ditch. You know your local postal workers by name and you share family recipes with the entire church congregation. Growing up in Big Sky Country meant long drives, open skies, and plenty of mom and pop shops. It was a big deal when western Montana got its first escalator. Now, we have more than I can count on my fingers (which still isn’t many). But wealthy outsiders like my opponent are trying to turn our state into a playground for the rich. They come into Montana, buy up luxury properties, and don’t give a damn about our way of doing things. As a third-generation Montana dirt farmer, these values are in my bones and come hell or high water, I’ll do whatever it takes to preserve our Montana way of life. This fight is personal to me. name: Sara Jacobs
subject: This is what they wanted all along
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sara Jacobs for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Two years ago today, our country became a significantly more dangerous place.
When the Dobbs decision first leaked, revealing what lay ahead, I was so angry that my whole body was literally shaking.
Imagining the inevitable pain, suffering, dehumanization, and death that the overturning of Roe v. Wade would cause felt like a nightmare.
But it was real.
In the past two years, we’ve watched people die as a direct result of dangerous abortion bans. Both maternal and infant mortality rates have spiked. People have been cruelly denied care over and over and over again, despite their doctors’ orders and their sincere wishes to be treated.
And all the while, we’ve watched Republican politicians make perfectly clear that THIS is what they wanted all along.
For a party that claims to be “pro-life,” where is the outrage at all this unnecessary death and suffering?
And it’s not just a lack of outrage, it’s actual celebration.
Donald Trump – the criminal who’s locked down the Republican nomination for President – has been downright cheerful in his credit-claiming.
I did it, he said.
It’s a miracle, he said.
I’m a woman of reproductive age, so this is deeply personal to me. But I know I’m not the only one struggling with this day, and this reality. Abortion bans don’t just affect women, for starters. Trans men, nonbinary, and gender-nonconforming people have lost their right to bodily autonomy, too.
And even if you’ll never, or never again, become pregnant, living in a society whose leaders are gleefully trampling on more than half the population’s basic freedoms takes a very real toll.
It can become easy to feel hopeless.
But we can’t lose hope.
We just can’t afford to – because we’ve got serious work to do. Not only is this fight not over, we actually have a shot at winning it this November.
We can vote out extremists and defeat candidates like my opponent who want to continue the crusade against our freedoms. We can elect and re-elect champions of reproductive rights. We can hold onto our hope – and deliver some to the next generation who is looking to us to right these wrongs.
But we can only do all that if we rise up together and act. It won’t be enough to hope if we don’t back it up with a massive voter outreach effort all across the country to turn out every Democrat we possibly can.
So today – on this awful anniversary – I’m asking you for help: Will you pitch in just $5 to my re-election campaign so I can defeat my anti-abortion MAGA opponent and support my fellow pro-choice Democrats in key races around the country? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
DONATE $25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?express_lane=true&amount=25]
DONATE $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?express_lane=true&amount=50]
DONATE $100 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?express_lane=true&amount=100]
OTHER [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
I know you get asked for contributions all the time. Not just from me, but from lots of candidates and organizations who are fighting lots of different battles. The reason we’re asking is that financial resources are absolutely critical to winning those battles. Campaigns that have more resources can reach more voters, period.
So if you’re able to chip in, I hope you do so knowing that it really does matter, and that your dollars can be the difference between losing and winning.
Thanks for taking the time to read this email.
-Sara

body:
We may need to change things | **I'm going to be brief, yet honest with you.**

Peter - Donald Trump Jr. here reaching out on behalf of Senate Republicans.

| | This is an exciting moment for Fair Fight. Earlier this month, Fair Fight announced their updated volunteer recruitment program — they’re cutting through the noise and letting extremists know that this democracy is ours. This new chapter in Fair Fight’s work will kick off a summer of organizing and educating voters about their rights, and all of this is critical as we look toward November. Across the country, we’re seeing systematic attempts by Republicans to marginalize voters of color and entrench their political power:
* The Supreme Court upheld a racially gerrymandered congressional map that diluted the voices of voters of color
* Last month here in Georgia, Governor Brian Kemp returned to his voter-suppression roots with the signing of SB189: an escalation of his consistent assault on voting rights. This legislation will go into effect July 1 and is expected to disenfranchise Black and brown voters, seniors and Georgia's unhoused population.

We also expect to see a rise in mass voter purges over the coming months as extremists wield false claims and misinformation to try to stop us from heading to the ballot box. **But we must continue to fight.** Fair Fight knows it will take a full-scale organizing effort to push back against anti-voter attacks and ensure free and fair elections — that’s why you’re a part of our movement, and I couldn’t be more grateful. Our democracy depends on ensuring every voice is heard, and every vote counts. We can't allow these manipulative, corrosive tactics to go unchallenged. We will meet them in the courts and at the polls. When we have the freedom to take our seat at the table and our place at the ballot box, we can elect leaders who govern in our interests, ensure every voice is heard and make the promise of democracy real for us all. This is our fight — thank you for showing up. Two years ago today, the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade and delivered a devastating blow to reproductive freedom and healthcare access nationwide, setting progress back fifty years.

The only way we can set it right is to win big in 2024.

Ro

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftcoribush?refcode=X_062424_dobbs [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftcoribush?refcode=X_062424_dobbs]
Peter,
In 2022, when far-right extremists on the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade , I was sitting in the same healthcare facility where I once had an abortion at 18 after I was sexually assaulted and became pregnant.
It was during this visit, alongside Secretary Becerra, providers, abortion fund administrators, and people who had their own abortions, where I learned Missouri’s extremist politicians had made our state the first in the nation to enact a near-total abortion ban after Roe was overturned. It was shocking and horrifying, but as a long-time advocate for our abortion rights, I knew our fight was far from over.
Now, for the past two years states controlled by far-right politicians have had almost full reign over our reproductive freedoms. That’s two years of relentless attacks on our reproductive rights, two years of attempting to ban IVF and birth control, and two years since we witnessed the stripping away of the right to essential healthcare for millions of people.
Let’s make one thing clear — we are witnessing the Republican Party’s long-term plan to ban abortion nationwide play out before our eyes.
As someone who has had abortions, I will ALWAYS fight to affirm access to abortion care as a human right and to expand access to life-saving healthcare.
It’s why I testified before Congress, led a Reproductive Freedom Tour across Missouri, and put my body on the line and was arrested in front of the Supreme Court in support of bodily autonomy.
It’s why I am the first lawmaker in the post-Dobbs era to call for the repeal of the Comstock Act – an outdated law from 1873 that makes mailing "obscene" materials, like contraceptives and abortion medication, illegal.
Anti-abortion extremists and the Republican party have shown they will stop at nothing when it comes to stripping away our reproductive freedoms. They aren't hiding their playbook; reviving the outdated and obsolete zombie statute, the Comstock Act , is the GOP’s latest hack to bypass Congress and impose a nationwide abortion ban. When people tell you who they are, believe them.
Last week, I was proud to team up with Minnesota Senator Tina Smith and Vermont Representative Becca Balint in introducing the Stop Comstock Act to repeal this antiquated law and prevent anti-abortion Republican extremists from making good on their promise to strip away reproductive rights for millions of people across our country.
And , it’s why I am at the forefront of our fight to enshrine gender equality into the Constitution — including our right to bodily autonomy — by finally publishing the Equal Rights Amendment . As the co-founder and co-chair of the Equal Rights Amendment Caucus and the proud lead sponsor of the ERA Now Resolution , I know that this is possible.
The onslaught of attacks on reproductive freedom is deeply personal to me, to my constituents in St. Louis, Missouri, and to the vast majority of people in this country. We must fight back against far-right, anti-abortion extremism and work to build a world where abortion care isn’t only legal for everyone but where it is accessible and equitable for all.
Our progressive movement has a champion in me. I'm working day-in and day-out to STOP the GOP’s attempts to restrict access to abortion care – and I'm not backing down. Friend,
A woman’s right to choose should not depend on where she lives.
For nearly 50 years, Roe v. Wade protected reproductive choice nationwide. But on this day in 2022, the radical, conservative majority on the Supreme Court stripped away those protections in the landmark decision Dobbs v. Jackson Women's Health Organization .
In the two years since Dobbs , Colorado has proven to be a safe haven for reproductive rights and women seeking care. But that’s not true everywhere.
Nearly every state touching Colorado has passed laws restricting abortion. And Republicans nationwide have used Dobbs to attack other freedoms too— like access to birth control, IVF procedures, and same-sex marriage.
In the Senate, I’m working to protect reproductive freedom everywhere — and when I’m not in DC, I’m working to elect pro-choice candidates in key swing states around the country and up and down the ballot in Colorado.
The anniversary of the Dobbs decision is a reminder of the fundamental rights American women lost — and what we must win back by working together.
Your grassroots support is critical to our work electing a pro-choice majority to Congress. Whether it’s $5 or $50, your donation makes a difference >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/embutton?refcode=X_062424_Dobbs_act]

Hey there.

I'll never forget the day I borrowed my mother's fur coat to go undercover as a prostitute.

It was a sting operation and I was a plainclothes officer.

I've got a lot of crazy stories from my time as a beat cop, detective, then precinct commander in the NYPD...

I saw my city go up in flames during the 2020 riots. I served on the SWAT rescue team. And I watched cashless bail and soft-on-crime policies decimate my city.

**My name 's Alison Esposito. After 25 years on the force, I retired from the NYPD to be Lee Zeldin's running mate when he ran for New York Governor in 2022. **

And we nearly pulled off the unthinkable in that race.

Since then, my life has taken a turn. I'm now running for Congress in one of the most closely watched races in the country. Many folks are saying whatever happens here will determine who controls the House Majority this time next year.

It's a 50/50, as-close-as-it-gets, true toss-up race in New York.

_**[So I'm teaming up with my friend, Steve Scalise, to help deliver this seat for the GOP, defend our Conservative House Majority, and save our country from soft-on-crime Democrats (like my opponent).](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/_x2IvaH6Kh1dPOXQk0cQXQ~~/AARclAA~~~ "So I’m teaming up with my friend, Steve Scalise, to help deliver this seat for the GOP, defend our Conservative House Majority, and save our country from soft-on-crime Democrats \(like my opponent\).")**_

We set a goal of raising 250,000 bucks before the end of June - _that will go a LONG WAY toward winning major races and stopping the Democrats from barging back into power._

I sincerely hope you're willing to help us out. We both do.

Why? Because the Radical Left Democrats are unloading 16 million dollars worth of attack ads in New York City ALONE. They have another 100+ million dollars ready to unleash at the drop of a hat. **That is enough cash to wipe out every vulnerable Conservative in every key state - including me!**

Which is why we are urgently calling on you for support.

_**[If EVERY strong Conservative reading this email agrees to pitch in SOMETHING, we'll hit our goal, catch up to the Democrats, and have the resources to fight back and win!](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/_x2IvaH6Kh1dPOXQk0cQXQ~~/AARclAA~~~ "If EVERY strong Conservative reading this email agrees to pitch in SOMETHING, we’ll hit our goal, catch up to the Democrats, and have the resources to fight back and win! ")**_

So I ask you now: can you please make an important contribution right now before our final June deadline?

---
Regardless, thanks for all you do for our movement. It makes a huge difference.

Take care,

Alison Esposito
_Conservative for Congress, NY-18_

I’m proud to endorse my friend George Whitesides in California’s 27th district. **This is one of the last GOP-held seats in Los Angeles County, and winning here will help Democrats win the House majority.**

**[Before I explain why I know George is the right candidate for the job, will you join me in supporting him with a donation of $3 or any amount today?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87516753/481398098/-731719488?refcode=em-6.24.24-all&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE1MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiZGNmMjk1Ni02NDMyLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=x7WhsP7b1lZCq-uIthgO7griMCEsqIJTsm_9FlkANss=)**

**Now, I want to use my experience to serve New Mexico in the Senate and get our country back on track. **

**And this is how we’re going to do it:**

**⇨** _Securing our borders to stop illegal immigration and the flow of deadly drugs._

**⇨** _Achieving energy independence to lower costs and strengthen national security._

**⇨** _Cutting unnecessary federal regulations to boost economic growth._

**⇨** _Supporting education options and opposing divisive curricula._

**⇨** _Addressing mental health issues with improved service._

**⇨** _Defending constitutional rights, including free speech and the right to bear arms._

**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. name: Gavin Newsom
subject: News on our Constitutional amendment on guns.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY CAMPAIGN FOR DEMOCRACY PAC
body:
Yesterday afternoon, the U.S. Conference of Mayors passed — unanimously — a resolution in support of amending the Constitution on guns.

Progress.
**Yesterday afternoon, the U.S. Conference of Mayors passed — unanimously — a resolution in support of amending the Constitution on guns.**
The resolution was sponsored by mayors from California, Oregon, Ohio, Georgia, New York, Missouri, Tennessee and Mississippi.
Blue states. Red States. Purple States.
Because gun violence is not a partisan issue. It impacts us all.
And the overwhelming majority of Americans from all communities and all political beliefs want more action on this issue.
I have said from the start that I was under no illusions about how difficult passing a Constitutional amendment on guns would be.
But it had to start somewhere — and in California we became the first state to call for a Constitutional convention on the issue. Now mayors from across the country are adding their voice. That's how it builds. And none of it would have happened without the demonstrated grassroots support for this issue.
**So today I have an important ask to keep us moving forward:**
[**If you agree we need a Constitutional amendment to make our communities safer from gun violence, then sign my petition today and join a growing community of people reaching out and educating voters and legislators about our Right to Safety Amendment on guns.**](https://act.gavinnewsom.com/signup/rts-petition-2024?source=em240624-1&akid=2082%2E4767699%2EAK4czv)
[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.gavinnewsom.com/signup/rts-petition-2024?source=em240624-1&akid=2082%2E4767699%2EAK4czv)
Congress has not done enough. The courts prevent Congress and the states from doing what has to be done. Given that reality, it's up to us — together — to act.
We need a Constitutional amendment on guns.
\- Gavin Newsom

body:
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/9?t=1&akid=38935%2E3422442%2EdtcUgK)
Derek,
This is some BS: **the state of Missouri has a total abortion ban** —without exceptions for rape and incest.
**[Can you make a $5 contribution right now that will be split between the campaign dedicated to ending this ban, Missourians for Constitutional Freedom, and my organization, Truth to Power?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240624-mo?refcode=em20240624-38935&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=38935_3422442_dtcUgK&akid=38935%2E3422442%2EdtcUgK)**
For two years since the _Dobbs_ decision, Missourians have been living under a total abortion ban. You see, politicians there had passed trigger laws, designed to ban abortion if the Supreme Court ever overturned _Roe._
Like you probably do, I still remember where I was when the news broke that _Roe_ would be overturned. I was making pasta for a sick kid after a long day. I thought to myself, _how can any politician think they are equipped to make the deeply personal decision to become a parent for someone else?_
While I’m proud that Californians have voted to protect access to abortion, **we can’t accept abortion only being allowed in some states as “good enough.”**
That’s why I’m asking you to support Missourians for Constitutional Freedom. Because of their work to get this amendment on the ballot, **Missourians will have the chance to end the state’s cruel abortion ban.** **[Anti-abortion groups will throw everything they can at this, and your support is critical.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240624-mo?refcode=em20240624-38935&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=38935_3422442_dtcUgK&akid=38935%2E3422442%2EdtcUgK)**
[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ttp-em-20240624-mo?refcode=em20240624-38935&refcode2=38935_3422442_dtcUgK&akid=38935%2E3422442%2EdtcUgK)
Just like in Kansas, Kentucky, and Ohio—I know that when voters have the chance to make their voices heard, they’ll stand up to career politicians who have taken away their freedom.
Thanks for supporting this fight,
Katie

**Katie Porter started Truth to Power to support Democrats who reject corporate PAC money** and are running to protect the environment, restore the nationwide right to an abortion, and create an economy that works for working people. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/truth-to-power-1?refcode=em20240624-38935&amounts=&t=2&refcode2=38935_3422442_dtcUgK&akid=38935%2E3422442%2EdtcUgK)**

name: Adam Schiff
subject: Deep sadness and anger
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR SENATE
body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=6797%2E5257348%2EKA2qkj ]Adam Schiff for Senate

Two years ago, the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade.

And our country hasn’t been the same since,
Derek.

The far-right, activist Supreme Court, with 5 justices appointed by
presidents who lost the popular vote in the United States, overturned 50
years of precedence and ripped away a fundamental freedom from millions of
Americans.

I’m still so angry at this decision.

Across the country, states have issued total abortion bans. Far-right
judges have come after medication abortion, in-vitro fertilization, and
more. Republicans in the Senate even killed a measure to protect the right
to contraception. Contraception.

And Donald Trump continues to double down on his anti-abortion stance.
He’s gloated about the undoing of Roe under his administration. And his
ultra-conservative allies are already drafting policies for him to sign on
Day One to take away abortion access — and more — in an effort to control
women’s healthcare decisions.

I’m running for Senate because we are up against a dangerous, anti-choice
presidential candidate in Donald Trump, and a radical Supreme Court
hellbent on forcing a social agenda on a country that does not want it.
And I’m up against my own anti-choice opponent in Steve Garvey.

Derek, from the
Senate, we can do something about it. We can stand up to these extreme
right-wing assaults on our freedoms — and we must. Here is what we must
do:

* Expand our Supreme Court: Mitch McConnell and Donald Trump stacked the
Supreme Court, and unless we want an entire generation to suffer, we
must unstack it.
* Impose Term Limits and an Enforceable Code of Ethics on the court.
* Abolish the filibuster: so we can continue to protect our fundamental
rights and freedoms so everyone can make decisions about their own
bodies, their own health, and their own future without the government
interfering in their doctor’s office.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2907?c0=june2024_abs_em.GGnUBV&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC90_20240624_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=6797%2E5257348%2EKA2qkj ]Derek, with
your support, I’ll make it to the Senate, we’ll protect the Democratic
Senate majority, and we’ll re-elect President Biden — and we’ll defend
abortion access. Please, will you pitch in to my campaign today?

If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation will go through immediately:

$100

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2142?c0=june2024_abs_em.2hsoac&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC90_20240624_PM1_V1_S1&email=&amount=250&t=1009&akid=6797%2E5257348%2EKA2qkj ]EXPRESS DONATE
$250

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=june2024_abs_em.iyuBSf&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC90_20240624_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1010&akid=6797%2E5257348%2EKA2qkj ]ANOTHER AMOUNT

This is an issue that affects all of us,
Derek. When a country starts
losing its rights, it starts losing its democracy. Access to abortion care
is about human rights and fundamental freedoms.

I’ve felt deep sadness and anger in the years since Roe was overturned —
that women today have fewer rights than women who came generations before.
But I’m deeply motivated to restore abortion access and fix the Supreme
Court to prevent future decisions like this one.

Thank you for empowering me during this fight.

— Adam

Friend, bodily autonomy is a basic human right and fundamental to democracy.
I lived in a world before Roe v. Wade and celebrated the court’s decision in 1973 to make abortion accessible. | | **Two years ago today, the Supreme Court reversed**** _Roe v. Wade_****with their decision in**** _Dobbs v. Jackson_****and declared that abortion was no longer a constitutional right.** In several states, this decision made a safe and essential health care procedure a criminal act overnight. **Abortion continues to be legal and protected in Washington because safe, accessible, and legal abortions save lives - not even the decision of the Supreme Court in**** _Dobbs. v. Jackson_****altered this.** **[Learn about abortion care in Washington](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87519680/481408540/-1295444077?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNGY1Mjk0ZS02YjMyLWVmMTEtODZkMi02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=fwW76qAaFj7TycWSSJDd8-NK7JWh4NKlmMj2ARnXkRg=&emci=45f9ef93-2930-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&emdi=04f5294e-6b32-ef11-86d2-6045bdd9e096&ceid=9494239)** **The Supreme Court's backward ruling in**** _Dobbs_****undermines our basic constitutional rights of liberty, privacy, and equality, which is why the American people overwhelmingly oppose the decision.** As a member of Congress with a 100% voting record on choice, and endorsed many times by Planned Parenthood, I will fight hard to codify abortion rights nationwide in federal law. Last fall, I joined a majority in the House to pass the Women's Health Protection Act, which would codify _Roe v. We know the extremists will not stop there — they are coming for access to birth control, and other established rights. **Our responsibility to fiercely protect and defend the right to an abortion is as urgent as ever.** The Moore-Miller administration will always support women’s reproductive freedoms and the right to choose. Wes has shown that he is willing to fight tooth and nail to protect reproductive rights because he knows the choice belongs to individuals, not extreme politicians. **Wes has already signed legislation protecting abortion access, but now he’s going further and supporting the ballot initiative to codify reproductive rights into Maryland’s state constitution this year.** **[Join our fight to protect reproductive freedom. Wade. In the time since that decision, many states proceeded to outright ban abortions, and continue to go even further to erode reproductive freedoms. We know the extremists will not stop there — they are coming for access to birth control, and other established rights. Our responsibility to fiercely protect and defend the right to an abortion is as urgent as ever. The Moore-Miller administration will always support women’s reproductive freedoms and the right to choose. Wes has shown that he is willing to fight tooth and nail to protect reproductive rights because he knows the choice belongs to individuals, not extreme politicians. Wes has already signed legislation protecting abortion access, but now he’s going further and supporting the ballot initiative to codify reproductive rights into Maryland’s state constitution this year. = | = Thank you for joining the movement to protect reproductive freedom, Team Moore

name: Sarah McBride
subject: The threat is real
body:
Today marks two years since the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade.
#
Today marks two years since the Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_.
On a day like today, I am reminded of the threat to all of us when the right to bodily autonomy is stripped away from women. **There is no true freedom without control over our bodies.**
Over the past two years, we have seen states like Texas ban abortions and threaten providers who offer this care. Now in states across the country, those seeking abortion care have to travel to get the care they need or get dangerous alternative procedures.
**Health decisions belong in the exam room, not in the halls of a legislative body or in a courtroom.**
That’s why in my time in the State Senate, I proudly worked with colleagues to make Delaware a safe haven for reproductive care, protecting the right to abortion in our state.
**But let's be clear: the moment anti-abortion Republicans are in control, they will ban abortion federally.**
This fall, we must elect a Democratic trifecta so we can do what the majority of Americans agree with — federally protect the right to abortion.
[**As MAGA extremists continue to criminalize abortion, I will fight to protect reproductive freedom and our right to bodily autonomy in Congress. Can you pitch in $5 to help me win this November?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240624?refcode=em20240624-688&amount=5&refcode2=688_21716_pNp8c-&akid=688%2E21716%2EpNp8c-)

body:
Emily Randall for Congress
Peter —
I was working at Planned Parenthood when Trump won the 2016 election.
I knew the anti-abortion movement would seize the opportunity. I knew our rights were in danger.
So that night, I decided to run for office – and do everything I could to protect reproductive freedom.
In the State Senate, we got a lot done:
* Protected the privacy of those who come from other states to receive care.
* Extended postpartum healthcare coverage.
* Strengthened our network of abortion providers.
* Required all health plans to cover reproductive healthcare and contraception, and more.

But anti-abortion judges and politicians are coming for our rights, state by state. Not just abortion, but IVF, contraception, paid family leave, and more.
**We need to take federal action, which can only happen if we hold this seat and take back the House. The last FEC reporting deadline before the primary is coming up FAST – can you contribute $6 or any amount today to help win this open seat?**

clean_body: I’m ready to take this fight to Congress so we can codify Roe v. Wade, ensure birth control access, protect in vitro fertilization, and stop a national abortion ban. | = | It’s been two years since the Supreme Court’s devastating decision to overturn Roe v. Wade stripped away our constitutional right to abortion access. I remember so clearly knowing I had fewer rights than the day before. = Sarah joined Vice President Kamala Harris in College Park today commemorating the anniversary. I’ve always championed access to reproductive healthcare – because this is about both lives and livelihoods. It’s about women’s ability to plan our families, determine our economic outcomes, and participate in our representative democracy. In the Maryland Senate, I voted for the Abortion Access Act, which expanded access to care and ensured the training of medical professionals to perform safe abortions in Maryland, and proudly co-sponsored legislation to enshrine reproductive freedom as a fundamental right in Maryland’s State Constitution. I’m ready to take this fight to Congress so we can codify Roe v. Wade , ensure birth control access, protect in vitro fertilization, and stop a national abortion ban. I refuse to stand back and watch as Republicans strip us of our rights.
| | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/87523146/481420960/1820369458?refcode=&amounts=5,25,50,100,250&&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDc1MjUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDI0NzAyYjQtNzMzMi1lZjExLTg2ZDItNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=SQLjk0vSb7pJQ9GReww9lL_e1U7KAorL7G1XSRIsKgg=)
---
Friend,
**Two years ago today, the federal right to an abortion came to an end.**
After nearly half a century of protections for reproductive health care and medical privacy, the Supreme Court's decision triggered an avalanche of cruel, deadly restrictions across the country — **leaving the United States once again fractured, now over the question of whether a woman has the right to decide what happens to her body, her future, and her life itself.**
As of two years ago today, the right of **169 million Americans** to choose was suddenly dependent on which state they call home, whether they can afford to leave it, and whether medical providers are willing to assume the legal risk that might arise from merely doing their jobs.
**And on that day, Republicans like Rick Scott, Ron DeSantis, and Donald Trump rejoiced.**
For years, the rights guaranteed in Florida's constitution made the Sunshine State a safe haven for abortion access across the Southeast. But when the Dobbs __ ruling came down two years ago today, that all changed **— and from then on out, nothing stood in the way of our extremist governor's increasingly strict limitations on this medical procedure.**
Without Roe v. Wade, some Florida women now have no choice but to travel 14 hours or more to receive abortion care. Some Florida women will be turned away from doctors' offices in the event of a life-threatening medical emergency. Some Floridians will die.
**Anti-choice Republicans do not care — and they will not stop until this is the case for every woman who calls our country home.**
Like many Latinos, I know what it means to have your freedoms stripped away by authoritarian leaders. My family came to America to flee that kind of oppression, and secure a better future for our families and generations to come — **so I refuse to accept a future where my daughters enjoy fewer rights than I did at their age._Ya no más._**
My opponent, Rick Scott, has proudly backed DeSantis' six-week ban. He eagerly co-sponsored the bill to enact a nationwide ban on abortions. Most recently, he released an ad promising to protect in vitro fertilization — **just one day after voting to block such protections from passing in the Senate.**
**That's why I'm in this race, friend.** I'm running to retire Rick Scott because I refuse to accept a world where out-of-touch extremists like him get to rip away our rights, then turn around and lie straight to our faces.
As I travel across Florida to spread the word about our movement, I'm determined to make sure Floridians know about the power we have this November:**not only to take back our rights from GOP extremists, but to hold them to account for being so foolish as to think we'd let them win.**
**And if our people-powered movement succeeds at ending Rick Scott's Senate career, reinstating Roe v. Wade as the law of the land will be at the very top of my to-do list.**
I will never stop fighting until the right to choose is restored to every Floridian, and every American, once more. I hope I can count on you to be in the fight with me.
Thank you,

Debbie
|

body:
Here's what you need to know about me:

|
---
Dear Friend,

Thank you for joining my team! I want to take a minute to introduce myself. I am a veteran, Christian, devoted husband and father, and an America First conservative running for Congress in Texas's 28th district.

After growing up in Austin, TX, I flew Blackhawk helicopters for the Texas Army National Guard on the Southwest border. After graduating from Texas A&M University, I became a U.S. Naval Aviator and Foreign Area Officer serving all over the world. In my 28 years of military service, I have helped our nation's allies secure the worst borders, only to come home to find ours kicked wide open, leaving our family's futures in peril from the most dangerous country killer weapon in history - weaponized mass migration -- an inhumane human bomb. My message is that our at-present lost security, freedoms, skyrocketing prices and morally detestable cultural attacks are just the beginning. Americans may soon find themselves in hand-to-hand combat for national survival -- at home - if we do not immediately deport Biden's 15 million invaders. Hidden among them (and us) lay this civilization's assassins. We do not know their identity, numbers, or locations, but we do know they are capable. If someone walked here through the Darien Gap, from Panama, then I'd put them up against the average American walking around today.

That is why I am running for Congress, because Biden and Democrat policies are simply the most radical and lawless in U.S. history. My Democrat competitor votes 96% with Biden in Congress. South Texans did not vote for fake borders, gender madness, weakened military, sky-high prices, energy dependence, more foreign wars, arresting our political enemies, spying on the American public, and giving-up gun rights.

Instead of just sitting and watching our state and nation burn to the ground, we must take action. The first step is to retire 14-time DOJ indicted Rep. Henry Cuellar. Henry has blood on his hands taking bribes to protect Muslamic Azerbaijan's genocidal march on Christian Armenia. He protected Mexican remittances over American interests boosting their business over ours. To do so, he hid behind dubious LLC's in his wife's and daughter's names. This person is not protecting South Texas, as he sells his own down the Rio. All the while voting to send our nation off the national cliff. Make no mistake, Texas is the Alamo all over again; and if Texas falls, America goes down.

Under Joe Biden and leaders like Rep. Henry Cuellar, our freedoms are under the constant threat of Marxist socialist's global agenda. With God's help, we will protect the values we are teaching our children. Their future is under constant attack from DC and the 160 nations to whom they are giving away ours. As Congressman, I will import bold South Texas leadership into the Swamp, to put America first and take back our southwest border, empowering all South Texas businesses, blocking woke insanity, and putting Texans back in charge of their day-to-day lives -- not big business, not big media, and definitely not today's Democrat run federal government.

**With your help, I will fight corruption in Congress, defend our families by securing the border, strengthen the dollar, restore our Constitutional rights, and defund woke Marxist socialism in our schools and public institutions. We have all had enough talk and pork barrel give-away politics responsible for our sinking national ship. Damn the torpedoes -- full speed ahead -- only together can we save the nation!**

Now more than ever, we need representatives who will stand up for our freedoms, not strip them away.

But they don’t know what they’re up against. They don’t know how powerful this grassroots movement is. **They don’t know that Team Vasquez is ready to defeat MAGA extremism at the ballot box a second time.**
Make no mistake: this race is going to be close. In 2022, I won by less than 1,500 votes, and NM-02 is one of just eight Democratic toss-ups in the House. But we’ve done it before, and I know we can win if each and every member of Team Vasquez steps up.

body:
Today is the anniversary of the disastrous Dobbs decision.
Peter,
**Two years ago today the Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_ , ending 50 years of federal protections for abortion rights. **
Since the _Dobbs_ decision, we’ve seen states like Texas outlaw nearly all abortions. We’ve seen far-right politicians pass laws that would jail doctors. We’ve seen people forced to flee their state to get life-saving reproductive care. And we’ve even seen attacks on other reproductive health such as in vitro fertilization, even contraceptives.
**This anniversary is a stark reminder that our fundamental freedoms are on the ballot. **Today, I met with Austinite Taylor Edwards. After years of trying to conceive through IVF, her baby received a fatal diagnosis at 17 weeks of pregnancy. Taylor and her husband traveled out of state for an abortion due to Texas law. Taylor is now suing the state with a group of women to restore and protect abortion rights.

body:
[1]Powered By People

Today is the two year anniversary of the Dobbs Supreme Court decision
which struck down Roe and paved the way for Texas’ current extreme
abortion ban.

According to a new report from the New York Times, 35,000 patients left
Texas in 2023 in order to receive an abortion. The Texas government is
forcing women to leave their homes in order to receive the medical care
they need.

With the Supreme Court against us, with Congress failing to enshrine
reproductive freedom into law when there was a pro-choice majority to do
so, with Texas Republicans willing to sacrifice the women of this state in
the name of an extreme agenda (we are at the center of a maternal
mortality crisis that is three-times as deadly for Black women, made worse
by a total ban on abortion access) is there any possible way for us to
overcome these challenges and restore this life-saving right for Texas
women?

The good news is that not only can we, Texans have done this before
against much longer odds.

A little more than fifty years ago, abortion was just as illegal in Texas
as it is today, and no one — not the President, not Congress, not the
Supreme Court — was going to ride to our state’s rescue. Instead, it was
Texas women like Jane Roe, and her attorneys Linda Coffee and Sarah
Weddington, who led the fight for Texas women to make their own decisions
about their own bodies.

Due to their courage, intelligence and tenacity these Texas women won the
landmark Roe v. Wade decision before an all-male Supreme Court in 1973,
fundamentally changing this country’s understanding of a woman’s right to
full personhood and citizenship.

Sadly, too many believed this hard-won victory was permanent. Maybe it
could be challenged and changed at the margins, but otherwise women in
America would never have to fear the government making decisions about
their bodies or their future for them.

Two years ago today, that illusion was shattered. The Dobbs decision
taught us that no victory is final, and the fight is never over. Much of
America was caught asleep at the wheel, unable to imagine, much less to
see, the methodical effort to destroy a half-century of accepted
precedent.

Now, we have an extraordinary opportunity this November to re-elect
President Biden and secure a pro-choice majority in both the House and
Senate. If we do that, we can pass nationwide abortion protections.

right now to support Beto and every single one of our volunteers who are
registering and organizing voters across the state?

Thank you,

Powered by People

body:
Sorry to be so blunt, but if we’re going to win in Arizona we cannot have bad days. We can’t miss our goals. And we absolutely can’t afford to have a prolonged slowdown like the one we’re in right now.
#

Peter, we’re at a bit of a loss here.
We’ve tried explaining the stakes of this election.
We’ve tried explaining how critical the FEC deadline at the end of the month is.
We’ve tried explaining how Arizona is the lynchpin we need to hold control of the U.S. Senate.
And we’ve tried over and over again to emphasize how dangerous, how damaging Kari Lake would be if she gained any more power and influence than she already has.
But still, our fundraising is down — not by a little bit, either. We’re having one of the worst slowdowns of the entire campaign at the exact moment that Kari Lake and her team are ramping up.
She’s raking in cash and she will use every dollar of it to beat us and impose her radical agenda.
Sorry to be so blunt, but if we’re going to win in Arizona we cannot have bad days. We can’t miss our goals. And we absolutely can’t afford to have a prolonged slowdown like the one we’re in right now.
We know we’ve asked a lot of you, and that these are incredibly trying times — but we can’t stop here. We’re asking you, respectfully, if you can chip in to Ruben Gallego’s campaign. We really need your help.
