| | Two years ago today, the Supreme Court ended national reproductive freedom for American women. Abortion rights in America didn’t live to see age fifty. I am facing a dystopian reality where I will have fewer rights than my mother, and my three year old niece may have fewer rights than me. Access to birth control, IVF, medication to treat miscarriages and abortion are no longer secure — even in California. The _Dobbs_ decision unmoored protections for our bodily autonomy. Today, our basic rights are now ricocheting around the US court system, uncertain which rights we may lose tomorrow. Decisions about how and when I become a mother and what health care I can use are no longer in my hands, or the hands of my doctor. **_Politicians like Kevin Kiley want to make that decision for me._** Although the California State Constitution protects our rights, Kevin Kiley is trying to change that. Kiley is leading the Republican Study Committee which is pushing an abortion ban called the _Life at Conception Ac_ t, which would ban abortion without exception, and criminalize IVF and even miscarriage. _Twenty one states have banned or severely restricted abortions since the_ Dobbs _decision._ This means _twenty one_ _states_ have seen _drastic_ increases in maternal and infant mortality over states with legalized abortion. Women aren’t getting treatment for miscarriages — women are dying of sepsis and being forced to carry dangerous pregnancies to term. Women’s health care providers are fleeing these states for fear of prison. **Abortion bans aren’t limiting unintended pregnancies.****_They are driving away health care for pregnant women._** The only way to protect reproductive freedom for women and families is for Congress to pass a law codifying _Roe v. Wade._ **As the only woman in the entire State of California flipping a competitive Congressional seat, I am working to get to Congress so I can help protect reproductive rights nationally and ensure women have a voice in Congress.** I’ll also work to invest in programs that reduce unintended pregnancy, like birth control and education. Let’s invest in programs that make it easier to choose to have children – like prenatal care, paid maternity and paternity leave, child tax credits, and affordable child care. subject: Democrats had 50 years to codify Roe. Do you trust them to get it done now?

body:
| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=dobbs_decision_anniversary&n=1)
---
Peter,

Two years ago today, the hyper-conservative supermajority occupying the Supreme Court struck down _Roe v. Wade_.

The _Dobbs_ decision marked the first time a civil right established by a prior court ruling and upheld by legal precedent for nearly 50 years was erased by a subsequent SCOTUS ruling. It’s an ominous sign of what’s to come if we do not reign in this rogue court.

I practiced internal medicine for 25 years. I remember the terrifying days before _Roe_. I remember watching close friends endure the horrors of back alley abortions.

Since _Dobbs_ , maternal mortality has shot up at least 24% – nearly 40% among Black mothers. And it’s going to get worse as more bans take effect.

At least 40% of American women and people who can get pregnant of childbearing age live in a state where abortion access has been severely restricted since _Dobbs_. Countless have had life-threatening pregnancy complications and been refused emergency care. Incidents of rape-related pregnancy have dramatically increased, with one study published by JAMA Internal Medicine finding 65,000 rape-related pregnancies in just 14 states with harsh abortion restrictions in the first 18 months after _Dobbs_.

Abortions will always be available to people wealthy enough to travel to jurisdictions where it remains legal. The simple fact is that abortion bans make women less safe, and make it more likely that women and children will get trapped in cycles of generational poverty.

**_We should be furious about all of that.

_** Yes, we should be furious with right-wing state legislatures that push radical abortion bans and the far-right governors and courts that put them into practice.

**But we should be equally if not more outraged by decades of empty rhetoric from Democrats. Their calculated inaction is no less a betrayal to women than the extreme right-wing lawmakers pushing these barbaric abortion bans.

** Lest we forget, in the 51 years since _Roe_ was first decided, Democrats controlled Congress nearly HALF of that time.

Every single Democratic president since _Roe_ held a trifecta (controlling both chambers of Congress and the White House) at some point in their presidency.

With his trifecta in 2021-2022, Joe Biden could have guaranteed abortion rights before OR after _Dobbs_. He didn’t.

**Never once in 51 years have Democrats made a serious effort to codify the right to an abortion into federal law. But they did raise BILLIONS of dollars from ordinary Americans who entrusted them to fight for us.

** This is not a fundraising issue to me. This is personal. As a doctor I know all too well that pregnancy itself is often a life-threatening condition. As an activist and a mother, I believe fiercely that no one should ever be forced to remain pregnant. **[As your president, I will leverage every tool at my disposal to safeguard our human rights and secure your right to healthcare – including abortion care.](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=dobbs_decision_anniversary&n=2)**
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=dobbs_decision_anniversary&n=3 "DONATE") [DONATE](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=dobbs_decision_anniversary&n=3)
---
Abortion _is_ on the ballot this year, and we should rightly question the willingness of Democrats to secure that right after squandering – intentionally or incompetently – every opportunity to do so in the last five decades.

Access to safe abortion is a non-negotiable human right. It is healthcare, and like all healthcare it should be guaranteed and freely available for anyone who needs it.

When I am president, it will be.

In solidarity and gratitude,

Jill

clean_body: | | | Peter, Two years ago today, the hyper-conservative supermajority occupying the Supreme Court struck down Roe v. Wade. The Dobbs decision marked the first time a civil right established by a prior court ruling and upheld by legal precedent for nearly 50 years was erased by a subsequent SCOTUS ruling. It’s an ominous sign of what’s to come if we do not reign in this rogue court. I practiced internal medicine for 25 years. I remember the terrifying days before Roe. I remember watching close friends endure the horrors of back alley abortions. Since Dobbs , maternal mortality has shot up at least 24% – nearly 40% among Black mothers. And it’s going to get worse as more bans take effect. At least 40% of American women and people who can get pregnant of childbearing age live in a state where abortion access has been severely restricted since Dobbs. Countless have had life-threatening pregnancy complications and been refused emergency care. Incidents of rape-related pregnancy have dramatically increased, with one study published by JAMA Internal Medicine finding 65,000 rape-related pregnancies in just 14 states with harsh abortion restrictions in the first 18 months after Dobbs. Abortions will always be available to people wealthy enough to travel to jurisdictions where it remains legal. The simple fact is that abortion bans make women less safe, and make it more likely that women and children will get trapped in cycles of generational poverty. We should be furious about all of that. Yes, we should be furious with right-wing state legislatures that push radical abortion bans and the far-right governors and courts that put them into practice. But we should be equally if not more outraged by decades of empty rhetoric from Democrats. Their calculated inaction is no less a betrayal to women than the extreme right-wing lawmakers pushing these barbaric abortion bans. Lest we forget, in the 51 years since Roe was first decided, Democrats controlled Congress nearly HALF of that time. Every single Democratic president since Roe held a trifecta (controlling both chambers of Congress and the White House) at some point in their presidency. With his trifecta in 2021-2022, Joe Biden could have guaranteed abortion rights before OR after Dobbs. He didn’t. Never once in 51 years have Democrats made a serious effort to codify the right to an abortion into federal law. But they did raise BILLIONS of dollars from ordinary Americans who entrusted them to fight for us. This is not a fundraising issue to me. This is personal. As a doctor I know all too well that pregnancy itself is often a life-threatening condition. As an activist and a mother, I believe fiercely that no one should ever be forced to remain pregnant. | "DONATE" Abortion is on the ballot this year, and we should rightly question the willingness of Democrats to secure that right after squandering – intentionally or incompetently – every opportunity to do so in the last five decades. Access to safe abortion is a non-negotiable human right. It is healthcare, and like all healthcare it should be guaranteed and freely available for anyone who needs it. When I am president, it will be. In solidarity and gratitude, Jill | "Support Jill Today!" name: Team Cornel West 2024
subject: Breaking News: Dr. Cornel West Needs Your Help in New York!
body:
Cornel West for President Campaign announces a strategic shift to a write-in campaign in the state

| | | [ ](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=new_york_write_in&n=1)
---
---
Dear Peter, We have an exciting update! Dr. Cornel West has reached a critical milestone: we are launching a write-in campaign for the New York ballot. This is a pivotal moment for our movement, and we need your support more than ever.
---
| [](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/ny_write_in?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=new_york_write_in&n=2 "READ THE PRESS RELEASE") [READ THE PRESS RELEASE](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/ny_write_in?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=new_york_write_in&n=2)
---
**The Challenge:** Despite our best efforts, the establishment is making it incredibly difficult for progressive candidates like Dr. West to appear on the ballot. The Democratic Party's entrenched power structures are working to keep grassroots movements like ours from gaining the visibility and traction needed to bring about real change. As Dr. West stated, "We must challenge the status quo and ensure that every voice is heard in this fight for justice and equality." **Why This Matters:** This write-in campaign is more than just a tactic; it's a statement. It's a declaration that we will not be silenced, and we will not allow the voices of the people to be drowned out by corporate interests and party politics. We are committed to a vision of America where justice, truth, and love guide our policies and actions.
---
---
**How You Can Help:**
* **Spread the Word:** Inform your friends, family, and community about the write-in campaign. Use social media, email, and word of mouth to make sure everyone knows how to write in Dr. Cornel West on their ballots.
* **Volunteer:** [Join our team](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/volunteer?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=new_york_write_in&n=3) to help educate voters on how to correctly write in Dr. West’s name. Every volunteer makes a difference in this grassroots movement.
* **Donate:** Your financial support is crucial. Donations help us fund educational campaigns, distribute materials, and organize volunteers to spread the message.

---
---
| [](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/donate?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=new_york_write_in&n=4 "DONATE NOW") [DONATE NOW](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/donate?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=new_york_write_in&n=4)
---
**Get Started:** [Visit our website](https://www.cornelwest2024.com/ny_write_in?e=2c4ab4fbefc09c0d9c12f8df438b31c5&utm_source=cornelwest&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=new_york_write_in&n=5) to learn more about the write-in process and how you can help us make history in New York. **Why Your Support Matters:** Dr. West's campaign is built on the foundations of economic justice, racial equality, environmental stewardship, and human rights. Unlike mainstream candidates, we are not beholden to corporate interests. This campaign is powered by the people, for the people.
---
---
## SPREAD THE WORD
---
---
We’ve included some social media posts and hashtags to help you spread the word:
* **Twitter/X:** "Stand up for justice! Join our write-in campaign for Dr. Cornel West in New York. Let’s challenge the status quo together! #West2024 #WriteInForJustice https://www.cornelwest2024.com/ny_write_in"
* **Facebook:** "Dr. Cornel West needs your help in New York! We’re launching a write-in campaign to ensure every voice is heard. Learn how you can support and spread the word! #West2024 #JusticeForAll https://www.cornelwest2024.com/ny_write_in"
* **Instagram:** "Exciting news! Dr. Cornel West is running a write-in campaign in New York. Join the movement for justice and equality. #West2024 #ProgressiveChange https://www.cornelwest2024.com/ny_write_in"

---
* * *
---
**Thank You:** Your support and activism are what keep our movement alive and growing. Together, we can overcome the obstacles placed by the establishment and bring about the transformative change our country needs. **In eternal love and solidarity,**
The West-Abdullah 2024 Campaign Team
---
Cornel West for President · 8253A Backlick Rd., PO Box #1577, Newington, VA 22122, United States

I apologize if you've been hearing a lot from me and my team, but the truth is, we're fired up because we have less than 200 days to win this race and take back the Senate. # [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1571%2E135344%2E6B9bRp)

Friend --
Let me start with the obvious: no one really likes to receive political emails. I don't either. And I get A LOT.
Out of all of the emails you receive over the course of the day, these aren't the ones you see and immediately want to open. They don't give you the same feeling you get when you see a message pop-up from a loved one or a long-lost friend.
But the unfortunate reality is that the response to these emails represent a significant portion of the money we have to raise in order to fund a winning campaign. Otherwise no one would think to send so many.
They're even more important when you make the decision -- like I did -- to reject corporate PAC money.
So I try hard to make these emails different than most other campaigns. There's no fake matches or over-the-top language. I either write or edit them all so you know you are hearing from me directly.
But that doesn't change the fact that we send them to a large number of people, realizing only a small percentage will give on any single day. And the hope is that over time, those donations add up.
I hope today is the day you choose to be one of the small percentage of people who got this email and choose to give. Republican spending has ramped up, we're in an FEC deadline month, and we're pacing short of our goals. So please:

On this day two years ago, the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade and allowed millions of people’s rights to be torn away.
#
Derek,
Today marks two years since the Supreme Court overturned _Roe v. Wade_. 👎
**The incredibly difficult, and personal, decision about whether to get an abortion should be between a woman + her doctor. End of story.**
The Supreme Court – _thanks to its three Trump-appointed justices_ – does not agree.
By overturning _Roe_ , the Court snatched the right to make intimate healthcare decisions away from women and instead gave that right to extremist Supreme Court Justices and other “local political leaders.” And they didn’t stop there.
Republicans have steadily stripped away reproductive freedoms with some states banning abortions and even threatening to punish healthcare providers who provide the service. 😠
Now, Republicans in Congress have introduced legislation for a national abortion ban. _**Not on my watch.**_
Republicans f*cked around with women's rights, now in November they're gonna find out.
I came to the Senate to be the 51st vote on crucial policy efforts like codifying Roe into law and you can count on me to stand up against every effort by Republicans to further restrict women’s rights.
We need to defend our majority in the Senate and restore reproductive freedoms back to the women of this nation, but **it’s going to take us showing up in a big way for reproductive freedom this November to stop these Republicans from taking away anymore rights.** 💯

body:
Luis Mata is running to represent District 49 in the Tennessee State House of Representatives.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240624&t=1&akid=850%2E587540%2EYwFp0a)
Peter,
I want to tell you a little bit about **Luis Mata** , one of the outstanding young leaders we’ve endorsed this year. He’s a **proud immigrant** originally from Guadalajara, Mexico, he’s worked as a **community organizer** for over a decade, and now he’s running to represent his community in the **Tennessee State House**.
When Luis was a kid, his mom made the courageous decision to leave Mexico and bring her family to a better life in Tennessee. As Luis tells it, his mom’s example instilled in him the values of hard work and resilience, and taught him that you can’t just sit around and wait for change — _**you have to fight to make it happen yourself**_.
[**Will you pitch in $5 to help Luis win his race and fight for the change we need? He’s running a grassroots campaign and needs our support to win.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240624-1?refcode=em20240624&amount=5&refcode2=850_587540_YwFp0a&akid=850%2E587540%2EYwFp0a)
Working hard to create a better future is nothing new for Luis. In order to get himself through college, he waited tables and worked as a legal assistant for the Office of Immigrant Services.
And in the midst of all that, he somehow found time to co-found a student organization called Students for Migrant Justice, turning it into a sort of political home for immigrant students.
After he graduated, he started working with the Tennessee Immigrant and Refugee Rights Coalition, serving families all over his state. As part of that work, he led successful electoral, legislative, and policy campaigns to advance and protect the rights and freedoms of immigrants.
Now Luis is taking his advocacy to the next level by stepping up to run for office himself. **If he wins, he would be Tennessee’s first ever Latino immigrant state legislator.**
It would be a historic milestone, and we’re determined to see it happen! The good news is District 49 is one of the _most flippable districts_ in the entire state — so I like our chances!

Peter, I want to tell you a little bit about Luis Mata , one of the outstanding young leaders we’ve endorsed this year. He’s a proud immigrant originally from Guadalajara, Mexico, he’s worked as a community organizer for over a decade, and now he’s running to represent his community in the Tennessee State House. When Luis was a kid, his mom made the courageous decision to leave Mexico and bring her family to a better life in Tennessee. As Luis tells it, his mom’s example instilled in him the values of hard work and resilience, and taught him that you can’t just sit around and wait for change — you have to fight to make it happen yourself. Working hard to create a better future is nothing new for Luis. In order to get himself through college, he waited tables and worked as a legal assistant for the Office of Immigrant Services. And in the midst of all that, he somehow found time to co-found a student organization called Students for Migrant Justice, turning it into a sort of political home for immigrant students. After he graduated, he started working with the Tennessee Immigrant and Refugee Rights Coalition, serving families all over his state. As part of that work, he led successful electoral, legislative, and policy campaigns to advance and protect the rights and freedoms of immigrants. Now Luis is taking his advocacy to the next level by stepping up to run for office himself. If he wins, he would be Tennessee’s first ever Latino immigrant state legislator. It would be a historic milestone, and we’re determined to see it happen! The good news is District 49 is one of the most flippable districts in the entire state — so I like our chances! Thanks, Peter. With your help, I know Luis and every single one of our endorsed candidates can win. David Hogg

name: Bryan
subject: Campaign Update
body:
What questions do you want the CNN moderators to ask at the debate? Fill out the survey below and let me know! | | | | |
---
| Happy Monday!
Here’s another update from the campaign trail.
**Trump’s Visit to Racine** President Trump visited downtown Racine last week and clearly laid out the contrast between the **failed policies of the Biden Administration and the pro-growth policies of Republicans**.
---
| It was great to see so many friends in Racine. It is clear that our party is unified and energized to keep control of the House, take back the Senate, and send Donald Trump back to the White House.
It’s up to us to turn Wisconsin red this November!
---
| | | | | | | | | |
---
|
---
[Click Here to Watch Part of My Speech!](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=a8d916f3b0&e=e907534017)
| **First Presidential Debate This Week** This week, Donald Trump and Joe Biden will face off in the First Presidential Debate of 2024. The debate will take place at 8 pm CT.
The debate is hosted by CNN but you can watch it live on any of your local cable news channels. If you don’t have cable, you can stream the debate on CNN.com.
---
| What questions do you want the CNN moderators to ask at the debate?
Fill out the survey below and let me know!
---
[Fill Out This Survey!](https://bryansteil.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5855432ef30dec79be4122095&id=ba282b8141&e=e907534017)
| **Upcoming Fourth of July Parades** I’ll be walking in **SIX** Fourth of July parades this year.
Our first parade is in downtown Kenosha on June 30. We’ll begin lining up at noon.
On July 4th, I’ll be walking in **FIVE** parades across Milwaukee County.
* Franklin
* Oak Creek
* Cudahy
* St. Francis
* Hales Corners

---
| We’re always looking for more volunteers to walk in parades.
If you’re interested in joining us this year, email **tripp@steilforwisconsin.com** and we’ll make sure you’re on the team!
On Wisconsin,
Bryan Steil
---
